jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position: Project Coordinator**

**Company:** Levelit Builders Inc.

**Location:** California (On-Site)

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**Salary:** $70,000 - $80,000 annually *(final compensation will be determined based on experience & skills)*

**About Levelit Builders**

We are a fast-growing, dynamic construction contractor operating with the agility, speed, and innovation of a modern startup. Based in California, we specialize in high-quality commercial interior finishes, drywall, metal stud framing, and radiation shielding systems. We take pride in delivering exceptional projects through smart project management, close collaboration, and a relentless focus on execution.

**The Role**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail-oriented **Project Coordinator** to support Project Managers and Superintendents in organizing, tracking, and executing commercial construction projects. They act as the primary communication bridge between field crews, subcontractors, architects, engineers, and clients to ensure projects stay on schedule, within budget, and fully compliant with project plans. If you thrive in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment where your impact is immediate, this is the role for you. Your scope of work will include but not limited to the following -

**Support to Project Managers & Superintendents:**

* Serve as the daily partner to Project Managers and Superintendents, bridging office operations with job-site needs.
* Track daily field progress, site logs, and superintendent notes to identify potential delays or scope issues early.
* Coordinate material deliveries, equipment rentals, crane schedules, and site logistics directly with field superintendents and trade vendors.

**Contract, RFI & Submittal Management:**

* Process and track RFIs, Submittals, Shop Drawings, and Product Data using commercial software (e.g., Procore, Autodesk Construction Cloud).
* Expedite long-lead commercial items (structural steel, glazing systems, major HVAC units) to match the superintendent’s field schedule.

**Subcontractor Management & Compliance:**

* Assist Project Managers with assembling bid packages, evaluating trade scope proposals, and drafting subcontracts.
* Collect and verify subcontractor Certificates of Insurance (COI) with commercial liability limits, safety logs, and lien releases.
* Ensure all trade contractors are properly onboarded and aligned with site safety rules set by the superintendent.

**Cost Control & Billing Support:**

* Review subcontractor pay applications against actual work completed in the field with the superintendent.
* Maintain Proposed Change Order (PCO) logs, tracking cost impacts from initial field discovery to client approval.

**Permitting, Inspections & Closeout:**

* Coordinate municipal building permits, utility sign-offs, and third-party inspection schedules for the superintendent.
* Track quality control checklists, testing logs, and superintendent-generated punch lists.

**Qualifications**

**Experience:** Project coordination experience with a general or trade contractor preferably focused on commercial drywall, framing, or interior systems supporting field & office teams.

**Skills:**

* Experience with in project management software such as On-Screen Takeoff (OST) & Quick Bid.
* Excellent communications skills between client interactions, project stakeholders, and field employees.

**What we Offer**

* Competitive base salary.
* 401K retirement plan with company match.
* Paid Time Off.
* Opportunities for growth & development.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Retail Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Retail Project Coordinator

**GoldUnion US – Beverly Hills**

GoldUnion, a global leader in buying and selling precious metals, is rapidly expanding across California, with a goal of opening **25 locations by 2027**. We are seeking a highly organized and proactive Retail Project Coordinator to support and oversee our retail expansion efforts across the state.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working on-site, solving practical problems, and being directly involved in getting retail spaces ready for business.

**Position Overview**

As part of GoldUnion’s retail expansion team, the Retail Project Coordinator plays a key role in managing and supporting the build-out and launch of new branch locations. This position is focused on project coordination, vendor management, timeline tracking, and ensuring operational readiness from planning through grand opening.

This is a field-based role with a home base in **Beverly Hills, CA**, requiring **frequent travel** between branch locations throughout California. A company vehicle will be provided.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and oversee multiple retail expansion projects from pre-construction through store opening
* Work closely with contractors, vendors, and internal teams to ensure projects stay on schedule and meet company standards
* Track project timelines, deliverables, and milestones, ensuring timely completion of all phases
* Conduct site visits and walkthroughs to monitor progress, identify issues, and ensure quality control
* Serve as a point of contact between operations, construction teams, and external partners
* Assist in resolving on-site challenges and ensuring projects move forward efficiently
* Support final setup and readiness of new locations prior to opening
* Ensure each branch meets operational, safety, and brand standards before launch
* Travel between locations as needed to support multiple active projects

**Candidate Profile**

* Previous experience in project coordination, facilities coordination, construction, or retail build-outs preferred
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to handle multiple projects simultaneously
* Experience working with contractors, vendors, or cross-functional teams
* Able to follow instructions, coordinate with others, and communicate clearly with internal teams
* Flexible schedule and willing to travel extensively across California
* Experience in retail expansion or construction project environments is a plus
* Strong work ethic, positive attitude, and willingness to learn are essential

**Compensation & Benefits**

* **Salary:** $55,000 per year
* Company car provided
* Gas and hotels fully covered during travel

**Working Hours**

* Full-time, Monday through Friday 10am-6pm
* Occasional weekends based on business needs and branch opening schedules

**Location**

* Office currently based in **Beverly Hills, CA**
* Frequent travel to branch sites throughout California required

**Recruitment Process**

* Initial phone or video interview
* In-person interview with the operations leadership team

**Required Notices (California & Federal):**

GoldUnion is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Reasonable accommodations are available as required by law.

GoldUnion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act. Background screenings and applicant information are handled in accordance with applicable laws.

The listed pay range reflects GoldUnion’s good-faith estimate for this position. Actual pay may vary based on lawful job-related factors. Commission and incentive earnings are performance-based and not guaranteed.

Offers of employment are contingent upon applicable lawful onboarding requirements and screenings.

Pay: $20.00 - $26.44 per hour

Benefits:

Experience:

* Project management: 1 year (Required)

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Organization Summary**

Since 1987, the Conservation Corps of Long Beach (CCLB) has worked to help youth realize their potential while serving the Gateway Cities area. As a state-certified Corps, CCLB is positioned to offer its Corpsmembers access to a variety of environmental work experiences while also facilitating personal development opportunities. More than 12,000 youth and young adults have benefitted from our unique program, and over 1,500 have received a high school diploma while working with us. We continue to serve local youth as we work towards achieving our vision of a world where all youth and young adults thrive, are resilient, have equitable access to opportunity, and are stewards of our community and the environment.

**Mission**

The primary mission of the Conservation Corps of Long Beach is to support young people in realizing their potential through work, service, conservation, and education.

**Position Summary**

At CCLB, our mission comes first. The Landscape Construction and Capital Projects Departments operate as a workforce training program, where Corpsmembers learn green infrastructure project implementation by working on real projects. This includes landscape installation, irrigation, hardscape, tree planting, stormwater improvements, and park and facility upgrades for public agencies and nonprofit partners. Every project has two goals: deliver quality work for our partners and prepare Corpsmembers for careers in construction and the green workforce.

Under the supervision of the Senior Project Manager, and in close coordination with the Director of Projects and Construction Training, the Senior Construction Project Coordinator will learn and take on construction administration for these projects from preconstruction through closeout. This includes budgets, schedules, RFIs, submittals, change orders, billing, and project correspondence. The position also supports crew coordination and plays an active role in training and mentoring Corpsmembers on the job.

This position is split between the office and the field. Approximately 60% of the time is spent in the office on project administration, and 40% is spent on job sites meeting with clients and inspectors, monitoring progress, and supporting crews.

CCLB is committed to growing its staff the same way we grow our Corpsmembers. Candidates do not need to come in with construction administration experience. The selected candidate will receive on the job training and mentorship from the Senior Project Manager and the Director of Projects and Construction Training in budgets, RFIs, submittals, change orders, scheduling, and project closeout, along with support to earn certifications such as OSHA 30 and First Aid/CPR. We are looking for someone who is organized, eager to learn, and committed to our mission.

**Construction Administration**

* **RFIs:** Prepare, submit, and track RFIs, and coordinate timely responses with designers, clients, and field staff.
* **Submittals:** Prepare and track shop drawings, product data, and samples for compliance with plans and specifications.
* **Change orders:** Prepare change order requests with cost backup and track them through approval.
* **Billing:** Prepare schedules of values, monthly pay applications, and invoices, and track payments and retention.
* **Correspondence:** Write clear, professional emails, letters, and meeting minutes, and respond to project inquiries promptly.
* **Documents and logs:** Review plans, specifications, and contracts, and keep RFI, submittal, and change order logs current.
* **Permits and compliance:** Coordinate permits, inspections, and DigAlert, and track insurance, bonds, subcontractor paperwork, and prevailing wage reporting.
* **Closeout:** Manage punch lists, as built drawings, warranties, O&M manuals, final inspections, and lien releases.

**Budgets and Estimating**

* Build, monitor, and report on budgets across multiple projects.
* Assist with cost estimates, quantity takeoffs, proposals, and bid documents.
* Request and compare vendor and subcontractor quotes, and prepare purchase orders.
* Reconcile project costs and revenue monthly with Finance, and code invoices to the correct cost centers.

**Coordination**

* Prepare and update project schedules, and flag delays early.
* Lead or attend preconstruction meetings, progress meetings, and site walks, and prepare agendas and minutes.
* Visit job sites regularly to check progress, quality, and safety, and document conditions with daily reports and photos.
* Coordinate crews, materials, equipment, deliveries, and subcontractors.
* Serve as a point of contact for clients, cities, agencies, design professionals, and partners.

**Supervision**

* Prepare weekly crew schedules and maintain the department project schedule.
* Supervise assigned field supervisors and their Corpsmember crews, as directed by the Senior Project Manager.
* Review and approve timecards in Paycom, and track labor hours by project.
* Lead tailgate safety meetings and support compliance with Cal/OSHA and CCLB safety policies.
* Help train Corpsmembers in landscape installation, irrigation, hardscape, plan reading, and job site safety.
* Mentor Corpsmembers on the job, helping them build construction skills, strong work habits, and confidence, and guiding them toward careers in the trades.
* Take part in interviews and orientation for new Corpsmembers.
* Assist with staff evaluations, coaching, and corrective action, and counsel, motivate, and discipline Corpsmembers as needed.

**Reporting and Record-keeping**

* Keep project files organized on the CCLB OneDrive.
* Make sure field supervisors submit daily reports, timesheets, and photos on time.
* Track daily project metrics and complete monthly metrics reports.
* Prepare weekly, monthly, and final project reports, including budget to actual reports.
* Prepare reports and presentations for sponsors, the CCLB Board, and City Council as needed.
* Report equipment and veh

Mission Statement  
The Salvation Army, an international movement, is an evangelical part of the universal Christian church. Its message is based on the Bible. Its ministry is motivated by the love of God. Its mission is to preach the gospel of Jesus Christ and to meet human needs in His name without discrimination.

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator (Scattered Sites) is responsible for all operational aspects of The Salvation Army-The Way In Youth Shelter scattered sites including management, programmatic, regulatory and fiscal compliance. The Program Coordinator provides professional, compassionate and safe care for all Transitional Aged Youth (TAY) program participants. The Program Coordinator will manage and supervise relationships with vendors, contractors and collaborators in coordination with program staff, Program Manager, and Director of The Way In.

Essential Functions

* Provide program coordination and individualized case management, advocacy, and referral services to transitional-aged youth (TAY) ages 18-24
* General monitoring of clients to ensure that a safe, quiet and friendly atmosphere is maintained in the in-home support
* Always maintain residential confidentiality and report any outside safety concerns (gang activity, neighbors, etc.)
* Ensure CES system coordination with community partners, collaborators, and regional partners.
* General monitoring of client’s needs to ensure a safe, welcoming, and accepting environment.
* Assist individuals in obtaining proof of housing readiness documents (ID, SSN, Birth Certificate, or VOD)
* Support individuals in developing foundational independent living skills, accessing mainstream benefits, securing employment, developing savings, and securing permanent housing.
* Regularly and accurately maintain participant data in HMIS and paper file, including complete documentation of all activities, services, and outcomes achieved.
* Maintain participant data in HMIS and paper file with complete documentation of all activities, services, and outcomes achieved.
* Log and gather necessary signatures for direct services provided to clients and report live updates to funder.
* Provide referrals to link participants to supportive services like mental health services, wellbeing providers, and other referral services as needed.
* Monitor and maintain documentation data quality with confidentiality, accuracy, and timeliness.
* Monitor TSA rental properties for public safety and cleanliness per Department of Public Health standards.
* Immediately report any pending upkeep, hazards, damage or concerns about TSA rental properties
* Maintain positive coordination and manage property relations with landlords on behalf of TSA.
* Document and report unusual occurrences, emergency incidents and injuries immediately to supervisor on-duty.
* Follow all program rules and TSA policies and procedures.
* Respond on-call and appropriately to emergency situations.
* Perform other duties as assigned by Director.

Working Conditions

Ability to walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel and twist on an intermittent or sometimes continuous basis. Ability to grasp, push, pull objects such as files, file cabinet drawers, and reach overhead. Ability to operate computer, fax and telephone. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs.

Minimum Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree with one year experience in related field (experience may be substituted in some circumstances)
* Experience working with transitional aged youth experiencing homelessness preferred
* Must be TB cleared prior to employment
* CPR and First Aid Certification
* Must have Class C Driver License
* Ability to drive and and pass a MVR
* Must have personal transportation as position requires local travel

Skills, Knowledge, & Abilities

* Driving Test, clean MVR.
* Ability to carry out assignments independently
* Computer literate in Microsoft Office Applications
* Knowledge of Homeless services resources in the community
* Knowledge of HMIS preferred
* Strong interpersonal skills with both clients and staff in a professional and respectful manner.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Requirements**  

The Digital Marketing Center of Excellence (COE) Operations team supports Disney Entertainment Studios, Disney Entertainment Television, and Direct-to-Consumer teams. The team oversees business operations, YouTube operations, social platform operations, and influencer marketing operations, while centralizing tools, vendors, and systems across the broader Marketing COE. The team partners closely with Technology, IT, Anti-Piracy, Legal, Finance, and platform partners on product and feature rollouts, vendor management, and payments. It also serves as the primary point of contact for social media and YouTube best practices across the COE.

#### **Job Summary**

Reporting to the Manager, Digital Marketing Operations, the Digital Marketing Operations Coordinator supports the Disney Entertainment Digital Marketing COE Operations team. The role assists studio, television, brand, and title marketing teams with day-to-day operational needs, including social account acquisition and setup, brand safety checks, and access permissions for internal employees and approved vendors.

The coordinator supports The Walt Disney Company’s (TWDC) content management system (CMS) environment, ensuring accounts are managed in accordance with company guidelines and industry standards. The role also supports daily invoicing and payment requests, ensuring payments are coded to the appropriate line of business (LOB).

The ideal candidate is collaborative, results-driven, and detail-oriented, with a strong understanding of social, digital, and emerging platforms. They manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment while championing consistent operational best practices.

#### **Responsibilities**

* Support social platform operations across the broader network by acquiring and setting up social accounts and managing verification, access, and permissions.
* Collaborate with internal teams and external platform representatives to troubleshoot issues and coordinate escalations with Cybersecurity and Anti-Piracy stakeholders.
* Perform quarterly account login updates and resets across owned and operated social accounts in accordance with brand safety and cybersecurity best practices.
* Conduct internal audits of owned channels and networks, including quarterly audits of internal network channels, to streamline operational workflows.
* Process CMS permission requests across TWDC while enforcing security and access controls. Support third-party tool integrations and maintenance, including Sprinklr and Crisp, ensuring accounts are connected for reporting and moderation.
* Create and maintain marketing email distribution lists across the Digital Marketing COE.
* Support invoicing, payments, and vendors by managing invoice submissions and payee payment requests, ensuring accuracy, compliance with company guidelines, and correct business unit or LOB coding.
* Track invoice payments and quarterly spending by LOB and provide senior leadership with monthly and quarterly spending reports.
* Partner with content leads on invoice submissions, troubleshooting, vendor setup, and Contingent Workforce Management approvals.
* Monitor overall budget and content development spending against the approved annual allocation and flag issues or overages to Finance.
* Support new vendor onboarding and investigate payment delays and other payment issues.
* Coordinate the request pipeline with the Royalties Processing team and communicate resource needs and timelines to stakeholders.

#### **Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum of 2 years of professional or internship experience in marketing, operations, social media, or digital marketing.
* Experience working in customer relationship management (CRM) tools such as Salesforce, Airtable, and Zendesk.
* Strong knowledge of social media platforms, including YouTube, Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and TikTok.
* Proficiency in using YouTube’s CMS.
* Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to communicate and implement operational processes.

As humans, there are few things more exciting than meeting someone new. At Tinder, we’re inspired by the challenge of keeping the magic of human connection alive. With tens of millions of users, hundreds of millions of downloads, 2+ billion swipes per day, 20+ million matches per day, and a presence in 190+ countries, our reach is expansive—and rapidly growing.

* **Take the Lead:** We don't ghost our work or each other. Just as users don't leave their matches hanging, we don't let each other down.

jobs.description:
About FWT Logistics

FWT Logistics is a motor carrier and third-party logistics (3PL) provider specializing in drayage, warehousing, and distribution services, with locations in Oakland and Carson, California.

Our Carson facility is conveniently located near the Ports of Los Angeles and Long Beach, allowing us to provide efficient transportation, storage, transloading, and distribution solutions to our customers.

We are seeking a dependable, detail-oriented **Client Services Clerk** to join our Carson team. This position plays an important role in supporting daily operations, maintaining accurate records, and ensuring our customers receive timely and professional service.

Position Summary

The Client Services Clerk will serve as a primary point of contact for customers, assisting with shipment inquiries, order processing, scheduling, and documentation.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, communicates effectively, and can manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced logistics environment.

Key Responsibilities

* Serve as a point of contact for customers regarding shipments, orders, scheduling, and service inquiries.
* Respond promptly and professionally to customer emails, phone calls, and requests.
* Enter, update, and maintain accurate customer orders and shipment information in company systems.
* Coordinate with warehouse personnel, dispatch, and operations teams to ensure timely processing and movement of freight.
* Monitor shipment statuses and provide customers with accurate updates.
* Prepare, review, and maintain shipping documentation, including bills of lading (BOLs), delivery orders, and proof of delivery (POD) documents.
* Assist with scheduling inbound and outbound freight appointments.
* Identify and communicate shipment discrepancies, delays, or service issues to the appropriate departments.
* Maintain accurate records of customer communications, transactions, and operational activities.
* Assist with billing documentation and verify information for accuracy.
* Support daily administrative tasks and operational reporting as needed.
* Build and maintain positive working relationships with customers and internal departments.

Qualifications & Requirements

* Previous experience in customer service, clerical support, or administrative operations required.
* Experience in logistics, transportation, warehousing, or a 3PL environment strongly preferred.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Outlook and Excel.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize responsibilities, and meet deadlines.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to customer service.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with a team.
* Experience with warehouse management systems (WMS) or transportation management systems (TMS) is a plus.
* Familiarity with shipping documents, container movements, and port-related operations is a plus.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of their responsibilities, communicates clearly, and understands the importance of providing reliable customer service.

The successful candidate will be:

* **Dependable:** Consistently follows through on tasks and commitments.
* **Detail-Oriented:** Maintains accuracy when handling orders, documentation, and customer information.
* **Organized:** Effectively manages multiple requests and competing priorities.
* **Proactive:** Identifies potential issues and takes initiative to resolve them.
* **Team-Oriented:** Works collaboratively with operations, warehouse, and transportation teams.
* **Customer-Focused:** Maintains professionalism and provides timely, accurate information.

Why Join FWT Logistics?

At FWT Logistics, we recognize that strong customer relationships and efficient operations are essential to our success.

You'll be part of a team that values accountability, communication, teamwork, and delivering dependable logistics solutions.

How to Apply

If you are organized, motivated, and interested in building your career in the logistics industry, we encourage you to apply.

**FWT Logistics is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

Pay: $25.00 - $30.15 per hour

Expected hours: 40.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

**Strategic Client Portfolio Lead + Team Oversight + Direct Client Leadership**

Hybrid (Irvine, CA)

The Smart Agency is an award-winning public relations, content, and marketing agency serving commercial real estate, housing, investment, and finance organizations nationwide.

We are seeking an **Executive Account Manager** to lead a portfolio of client programs, mentor account team members, and partner directly with senior client leadership to shape communications strategies aligned with business goals.

This is a **player-coach role**. You will lead some accounts directly while guiding strategy across additional accounts managed by teammates.

Earned media strategy including pitching, securing coverage, shaping executive messaging, and ensuring placements support broader communications goals is central to this role.

**Why This Role Exists**

Our clients are senior leaders making decisions in fast-moving industries shaped by investment cycles, development timelines, regulatory changes, and market conditions.

They rely on us not just to secure coverage but to help them decide **how they should show up publicly and why**.

This role exists to help clients:

* translate business priorities into communications strategy
* strengthen executive positioning in their markets
* stay proactive during periods of change
* connect earned media to broader visibility goals across channels

You help shape how organizations are understood by investors, partners, tenants, and the industry.

**What You’ll Own**

Executive Account Managers are responsible for the **health, alignment, and growth of a portfolio of accounts**.

You will:

* lead communications strategy across multiple client programs
* manage several client relationships directly
* guide accounts run by junior team members
* mentor account staff
* strengthen executive visibility programs
* support long-term retention and scope growth
* ensure earned media supports broader communications strategy across channels

**What You’ll Do**

**Lead Client Strategy**

You will:

* guide communications direction tied to business priorities
* partner directly with client C-suite, senior leadership or marketing teams
* shape annual communications planning
* support messaging during moments of change or opportunity
* help clients make positioning decisions when direction is still forming

**Lead Earned Media Strategy Across Accounts**

You will:

* secure media placements and opportunities each month
* guide story positioning and pitch direction
* support announcement and thought-leadership strategies
* strengthen relationships with key reporters and editors
* review press releases and executive messaging
* ensure placements support broader communications goals
* coordinate with social and production teams so coverage is amplified across newsletters and digital channels

**Support Accounts Managed by Teammates**

You will:

* advise account leads on strategy
* monitor placement quality and account alignment
* step in when additional support is needed
* identify opportunities to strengthen or expand programs

You are accountable for outcomes even when not managing day-to-day execution.

**Mentor and Support the Team**

You will:

* provide writing and strategic feedback
* support onboarding of new staff
* strengthen account coverage across teams
* contribute input during hiring discussions when appropriate

**What Makes This Role Challenging (and Interesting)**

This role sits at the intersection of client strategy, media positioning, and team leadership.

Strong candidates enjoy:

* working across multiple clients at once
* advising executives directly
* adjusting communications plans as priorities evolve
* helping clients clarify positioning during change
* balancing short-term announcements with long-term reputation goals

Success requires judgment not just execution.

**What You’ll Get to Influence**

In this role, you will help shape:

* how executives position their organizations publicly
* which stories define a company’s reputation
* how announcements are framed during key business moments
* how earned media connects with broader communications strategy
* how junior team members grow into stronger account leaders

**What Success Looks Like in the First 6 Months**

Within your first six months, you will typically:

* build strong working relationships with assigned clients
* guide messaging direction across multiple client PR / communication programs
* successfully secure strategic media placements across key accounts
* identify at least one opportunity to expand a client program

**Traits That Lead to Success**

Strong candidates:

* bring grit, resilience, and a strong work ethic, especially when priorities shift or challenges arise
* stay calm and solutions-focused in fast-moving or ambiguous situations
* take initiative and follow through without needing constant direction
* communicate clearly and professionally with clients, media, and internal teams
* approach work with accountability, curiosity, and a willingness to keep learning
* remain adaptable and positive when plans change or timelines tighten
* support and guide teammates while fostering trust and independence
* proactively look for opportunities to add value and support team goals
* connect communications work to business outcomes

**How This Role Grows**

People who succeed in this role often grow into:

* leading larger client portfolios
* shaping service offerings
* managing teams or business lines
* supporting agency positioning and new business strategy

**Experience We’re Looking For**

Typically:

* 7+ years in public relations or strategic communications
* experience guiding multi-account programs
* strong earned media background
* experience mentoring junior staff
* comfort working with senior leadership teams

Experience in commercial real estate, housing, finance, or investment sectors preferred.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

jobs.title: Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant
jobs.description:
**Your Role**

The Privacy Office develops and oversees Blue Shield’s Privacy Program. The Privacy Program ensures that Blue Shield and its affiliated covered entities, including Blue Shield of California Promise Health Plan, are in compliance with state and federal privacy laws and regulations, including the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA), the Health Information Technology for Economic and Clinical Health Act of 2009 (HITECH), and California’s Confidentiality of Medical Information Act (CMIA). The Privacy Program Specialist, Consultant reports to the Privacy Office Manager or Director and plays an essential role in advancing and enforcing Blue Shield’s Privacy Program.

  

**Your Work**

In this role, you will:

* Support the Privacy Office’s oversight of Blue Shield's compliance with applicable state and federal privacy laws, including HIPAA and HITECH
* Lead assigned privacy inquiries that involve responding to individual rights requests and questions, privacy complaints, and requests for privacy guidance, as the primary focus of this role
* Manage all aspects of assigned cases, including regulatory analysis, prompt follow-up, and timely and accurate documentation of case files. Identify matters requiring escalation and, when appropriate, direct business units in conducting root-cause analysis, and implementing mitigation and remediation efforts
* Assist, evaluate, and determine appropriateness of ad hoc requests from internal clients to disclose protected health information (PHI) to third parties, including employer-sponsored health plans, and/or to allow third parties access to, or use of, Blue Shield PHI
* Consult with internal clients as a subject matter expert, providing privacy guidance about proposed projects and enterprise-wide initiatives that involve the access, use, or disclosure of Blue Shield PHI
* Develop and assist with the implementation of workforce privacy trainings, privacy policies, desk level procedures, resource guides, job aids, and other educational tools
* Audit and monitor compliance with the Privacy Program, develop and implement corrective action plans (CAPs) on behalf of the Privacy Office, advise on CAPs issued by other business units that include privacy-related components, and conduct Privacy Impact Assessments and Data Protection Impact Assessments
* When internal business needs arise, assist with negotiating Business Associate Agreements, lead privacy investigations, and act as a liaison with regulatory enforcement agencies to address technical assistance letters, investigation compliance reviews, audits, and other related reviews
* Perform other duties as assigned

  

**Your Knowledge and Experience**

* Requires a bachelor’s degree or High School Diploma/GED and 4 years of additional relevant experience in lieu of a degree
* Requires at least 7 years of prior relevant experience in healthcare privacy, healthcare compliance, health information management functions related to fulfilling individual rights requests, or another related field
* Requires a deep working knowledge and application of California state and federal privacy laws, including HIPAA/HITECH, CMIA, minor consent laws, and privacy-related consumer protections laws, such as the Telephone Consumer Protection Act (TCPA). Additionally, a solid understanding of Department of Health Care Services (DHCS) and Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) privacy requirements
* Preferred: Privacy compliance health plan experience that includes familiarity with Privacy Impact Assessments; health information management; auditing and monitoring; investigating, managing, and reporting privacy incidents; corporate compliance training
Preferred: CIPP/US Certification or HCCA CHPC Certification

Employees living more than 50 miles from an office location will work with their manager to determine in-office time based on business need.

Avante Aesthetics is a boutique luxury medical spa located at 1520 North Main Street in Walnut Creek, California. We specialize in advanced aesthetic treatments, including injectables, laser services, skin resurfacing, body contouring, and wellness, with a focus on natural results and an exceptional client experience.

As our practice continues to grow, we are looking for a highly organized, proactive, and personable Front Office Coordinator who can help keep our office running smoothly while delivering outstanding customer service.

**Position Overview**

This is much more than a traditional receptionist position. We are looking for a true go-getter who takes initiative, thinks quickly on their feet, works exceptionally well independently, and takes pride in keeping an office organized and operating efficiently.

The right person will be comfortable managing front desk responsibilities, coordinating schedules, tracking inventory, maintaining a clean and welcoming environment, following up with clients, and identifying opportunities to improve the business.

**Spanish-speaking ability is almost a must for this position.** We strongly prefer someone who can comfortably communicate with Spanish-speaking clients in a professional setting.

We are looking for someone dependable, resourceful, and motivated to become an important part of a growing boutique medical spa.

**Key ResponsibilitiesFront Desk & Office Operations**

* Serve as the first point of contact for clients by phone, text, email, and in person.
* Manage appointment scheduling, confirmations, cancellations, and rescheduling.
* Keep the reception area and client spaces clean, organized, and welcoming.
* Monitor inventory of skincare products, office supplies, and other essentials.
* Track inventory levels and coordinate timely reordering.
* Process payments and assist with administrative tasks.
* Anticipate office needs and take initiative to resolve routine issues.
* Help ensure daily operations run smoothly without constant supervision.

**Client Relations & Customer Service**

* Deliver exceptional, personalized customer service consistent with a luxury medical spa.
* Handle incoming inquiries professionally and promptly.
* Conduct client callbacks and follow up with prospective and existing clients.
* Follow up with missed inquiries, consultation leads, and clients due for rebooking.
* Help convert inquiries into booked consultations and appointments.
* Build positive, lasting client relationships and encourage repeat visits.
* Communicate professionally with English- and Spanish-speaking clients.
* Handle client concerns with patience, discretion, and sound judgment.

**Client Engagement & Business Growth**

* Help maintain strong client relationships and improve client retention.
* Follow up consistently with leads and prospective clients.
* Support the promotion of treatments, packages, memberships, and skincare products.
* Identify opportunities to increase bookings and encourage rebooking.
* Bring forward ideas to improve the client experience and daily operations.
* Contribute to a positive, professional environment that supports the growth of the practice.

**Social Media & Marketing Support**

Social media experience is a strong plus, although it is not the primary responsibility of this position.

* Help create short videos, reels, and stories for Instagram and TikTok.
* Assist with filming and editing content featuring treatments, skincare, and the practice.
* Suggest creative ideas to increase brand awareness and client engagement.
* Use tools such as Canva or CapCut, if familiar.
* Help identify opportunities to turn social media interest into client inquiries and appointments.

**Qualifications**

* Strong customer service experience is essential.
* **Spanish proficiency is strongly preferred and close to essential for this position.**
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Highly organized, dependable, and detail-oriented.
* Able to work independently and take ownership of responsibilities.
* Quick-thinking problem solver who can adapt to changing priorities.
* Strong follow-through and time management.
* Comfortable using computers, email, scheduling software, and spreadsheets.
* Professional, personable, and attentive to detail.
* Genuine interest in aesthetics, skincare, beauty, and wellness.

**Preferred experience:**

jobs.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We're redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall's AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We've built a product customers love and a business that's scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.

At Aircall, you'll join a company in motion. We're ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

  

**How we work at Aircall**: We're customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you'll feel at home here.

As a Confirmed Account Manager at Aircall, you are the owner of customer success and revenue growth across your portfolio. You drive Net Revenue Retention (NRR) by uncovering opportunities to expand, renew, and strengthen customer relationships. Acting as both the voice of Aircall for the customer and the voice of the customer within Aircall, you ensure our customers realize the full value of their investment while fueling sustainable growth for Aircall.

By deeply understanding the needs of our customers across a variety of industries and use cases, you become the trusted expert who identifies growth potential and helps improve the customer experience. This means translating customer goals into solutions that unlock adoption, value realization, and expansion — ensuring each account grows in both impact and partnership over time.

This is a highly strategic and commercial role — blending consultative relationship management with the rigor and energy of a quota-carrying seller. You'll partner cross-functionally with Customer Engineering, Product, and Support to accelerate adoption, drive usage of add-on SKUs, and build deep, long-term relationships with customers at all levels of their organizations.

Aircall is undergoing an exciting transformation — building on our market-leading communications platform and introducing AI functionality that helps customers operate more intelligently, efficiently, and competitively. Join us and be part of shaping that journey.

**This is a hybrid role based in New York and San Francisco.**

### **Key Responsibilities:**

* Own NRR: Manage the full post-sale lifecycle — driving renewals, expansions, and churn mitigation to deliver predictable and profitable growth.
* Drive Growth: Identify and activate growth opportunities within your portfolio, prospecting into new subsidiaries, use cases, and additional SKUs to unlock untapped potential.
* Target Strategically: Prioritize high-potential accounts that may have low spend today but represent strong expansion opportunities, developing long-term growth plans.
* Prospect and Outbound: Run proactive outreach within your base to expand relationships and identify new value creation opportunities.
* Develop Stakeholder Maps: Build and maintain multi-layer relationships — from daily users to senior decision-makers — ensuring alignment, sponsorship, and retention.
* Sell Competitively: Position Aircall's value head-to-head against competitors, with a clear understanding of how our solutions address each customer's unique business needs.
* Negotiate and Close: Lead complex renewal and upsell negotiations, balancing commercial outcomes with customer success to close revenue and foster loyalty.
* Manage Pipeline & Forecast: Maintain an accurate pipeline of renewal and expansion opportunities and deliver consistent, data-driven NRR forecasting.
* Partner for Adoption: Collaborate closely with your Customer Engineering counterpart to ensure customers achieve adoption milestones and measurable outcomes.
* Champion the Customer Voice: Surface insights, pain points, and product feedback that inform Aircall's product roadmap and go-to-market strategies.
* Shape Local Strategy: Share learnings across teams to enhance customer experience and strengthen regional growth initiatives.

  

### **Qualifications:**

* Experienced in SaaS Account Management, Commercial Customer Success, or Renewal Management, with a track record of achieving revenue targets.
* Skilled in consultative sales, prospecting, and negotiation, with the ability to balance commercial focus and customer advocacy.
* Customer-obsessed — curious about how different industries and use cases leverage Aircall, and proactive in identifying ways to add value.
* Capable of developing and executing account expansion strategies, including stakeholder mapping and whitespace analysis.
* Confident in competitive sales cycles, able to articulate differentiation and handle objections effectively.
* Analytical, detail-oriented, and accountable for forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene.
* Resilient, driven, and passionate about helping customers realize long-term value through partnership.
* Excited by innovation and transformation — particularly the opportunity to represent a next-generation AI-powered communications platform.

jobs.title: Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About the Role**

We are a premier, board-certified plastic surgery practice seeking a creative and driven Social Media & Digital Marketing Manager to own our entire digital presence. This is a highly visible, hands-on role: you will develop strategy, produce content, manage our website, and grow our brand across all platforms — all from within our practice. The ideal candidate brings a passion for aesthetics, a sharp eye for visual storytelling, and a proven track record of audience growth in a luxury or healthcare-adjacent environment.

**Social Media Responsibilities**

***Strategy & Campaign Planning***

▸ Develop, own, and execute a comprehensive social media strategy across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and emerging platforms relevant to the aesthetic industry

▸ Build and manage monthly content calendars at least 30 days in advance, maintaining a minimum of 5–7 posts per week with at least 3 surgical/procedural posts weekly

▸ Conduct ongoing competitive research and audience analysis to spot trends and opportunities within the plastic surgery and medical aesthetics space

▸ Define and consistently uphold the practice's brand voice — aspirational, approachable, educational, and trustworthy

▸ Plan and execute promotional campaigns around seasonal specials, new service launches, events, and practice milestones

***Content Creation & Production***

▸ Plan, film, direct, and edit high-quality short-form video for Reels, TikToks, and YouTube Shorts — with the capability to capture, edit, and publish surgical content same-day when consented

▸ Coordinate directly with the surgeon and clinical staff to document procedures, patient journeys, recovery timelines, and behind-the-scenes content — always in full HIPAA compliance

▸ Photograph procedures, results, staff, and practice culture to maintain a rich, diverse content library

▸ Design polished graphics, Story assets, promotional flyers, and branded templates using Adobe Creative Suite, Canva, or equivalent tools

▸ Write compelling, on-brand captions, hashtags, and calls-to-action tailored to each platform's algorithm and audience

***Community Management & Growth***

▸ Monitor and respond to all comments, DMs, and brand mentions across platforms in a timely, professional, and brand-consistent manner

▸ Build and manage influencer partnerships, patient ambassador relationships, and co-branded content opportunities

▸ Drive sustained organic follower growth through engagement strategies, trending audio/format adoption, and strategic hashtag use

▸ Coordinate giveaways, live sessions, Q&As, and other engagement-boosting activations in collaboration with the surgeon

***Paid Social & Analytics***

▸ Create, manage, and optimize paid advertising campaigns on Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok — including audience targeting, creative testing, and budget management

▸ Track and report weekly and monthly KPIs: reach, impressions, engagement rate, follower growth, link clicks, and patient inquiry volume attributed to social

▸ Use performance data to continuously refine content strategy, posting cadence, and paid spend allocation

**Website & Digital Marketing Responsibilities**

***Website Management & Content***

▸ Maintain, update, and optimize the practice website (WordPress or equivalent CMS), including procedure pages, physician bio, photo galleries, and patient resources

▸ Publish a minimum of two SEO-optimized blog posts per month targeting high-value keywords (procedure names, recovery FAQs, local search terms)

▸ Keep before-and-after photo galleries current, properly categorized, and compliant with signed patient consent documentation

▸ Coordinate with developers or external agencies for larger technical projects, site redesigns, or platform integrations

***SEO & Online Reputation***

▸ Monitor and respond professionally to patient reviews on Google, RealSelf, Yelp, and Healthgrades — escalating concerns to management as appropriate

▸ Maintain and regularly update the practice's Google Business Profile, including photos, posts, hours, and service descriptions

***Email Marketing & CRM***

▸ Design and distribute monthly email newsletters featuring promotions, educational content, provider spotlights, and practice news

▸ Build and manage automated email sequences for consultation follow-ups, post-operative engagement, and seasonal campaigns

▸ Manage patient email list segmentation, list hygiene, and compliance (CAN-SPAM / HIPAA) within the practice's CRM or email platform

**Required Qualifications**

▸ 2+ years of hands-on experience in social media management and digital marketing — ideally within plastic surgery, aesthetics, med-spa, dermatology, or luxury healthcare

▸ Demonstrated portfolio of high-performing short-form video content (Reels, TikToks) that drove measurable engagement and follower growth

▸ Proficiency across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube — including a clear understanding of each platform's algorithm, format, and audience

▸ Hands-on video shooting and editing experience (CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, or equivalent)

▸ Experience managing a business website via WordPress or a comparable CMS, including content updates and basic SEO

▸ Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager for creating and optimizing paid social campaigns

▸ Strong written communication skills — capable of producing polished captions, blog posts, email copy, and patient-facing messaging

▸ Working knowledge of HIPAA regulations as they apply to patient photography, testimonials, and social media content

▸ Highly organized, self-motivated, and able to independently manage multiple concurrent projects and deadlines

**Preferred Qualifications**

▸ Direct experience working in-house for a physician, surgeon, or aesthetics practice

▸ Familiarity with RealSe

**About Watershed**
-------------------

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

**The role**
------------

We’re looking for ambitious sales development hires to bring Watershed to more companies. We’re at an inflection point: every large company is launching a climate program as pressure for action builds every day. You’ll do whatever it takes to get those companies engaged on climate and excited about working with Watershed. As an early member of our go-to-market organization, you’ll help build the sales playbook, shape Watershed’s product, help us build a stellar team, and accelerate pipeline across North America.

This hire must be in our HQ in San Francisco.

**You will:**

* Open doors. Take a data-driven approach to prospecting that builds a pipeline across key customer segments, while building connections and establishing Watershed’s brand in markets we will be entering soon.
* Inspire action. Persuade prospects of the urgency of climate action and help them understand how Watershed can help them build a high-impact program, fast.
* Communicate like an expert. Companies will feel delighted and informed by your interactions, looking to you for both climate and Watershed product expertise.
* Take extreme ownership. Identify and actively address inefficiencies, : we need to leverage our tools for prospecting at speed
* Become an expert in climate, and educate companies on how they should navigate the world of carbon reduction targets, clean energy, carbon removal, and decarbonizing their supply chain.

**You might be a fit if:**

* You have 1-3 years of experience in sales or sales development and a consistent record of over-achieving your goals.
* You take extreme ownership of our customers’ first impressions of Watershed. Customers you’ve worked with in the past should rave about working with you.
* You’re flexible, adaptive, and resilient with a history of leaving systems, processes, and content better than you found them.
* You have a great attitude, a love of close team collaboration, and a desire to move and grow quickly in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Role Location**: This role will be based in our San Francisco HQ with the expectation of being in office 4x/week.

**Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)**

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

**What’s the interview process like?**

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

**What if I need accommodations for my interview?**

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

Metrics

Leading Indicators

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month
* Leading Indicator: Meeting to opportunity conversion rate

Outcomes:

* Number of sourced opportunities
* Closed/won revenue

Responsibilities

* Build our pipeline! Prospect and generate leads through cold calling, emails and social selling
* Be the first point of contact: Qualify inbound leads and set meetings for account executives
* Build and maintain relationships with innovative brokers, ecosystem partners and prospects
* Evangelize Aware Health’s value proposition, building demand for our solution
* Keep data updated in Hubspot CRM
* Strategically contribute to and drive the development of outreach strategies
* Collaborate with account executives to optimize conversion rate and sales pipeline
* Participate in the continuous improvement of the sales process (your voice matters to us!)
* Share insights about market trends and feedback from prospects to help refine our go to market strategy
* Partner with the Head of Growth to nurture and work deals from initial prospecting through close (we’re excited to train you up so you’ll be closing your own deals in this complicated industry over time!)

Why You’ll Love This Role

* Real-time access to executives who are invested in your growth
* A collaborative and fast-paced start up environment where your voice matters
* An impact-driven mission where you can feel great about the product you’re selling
* A clear career path to AE and beyond

Qualifications

* Experience in sales or lead generation, preferably in health tech, insurance, or a B2B sales environment
* Proven track record of meeting activity and lead-generation targets
* Excellent communication skills with a focus on relationship-building and consultative selling
* Self-starter with the ability to succeed with limited resources
* Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably Hubspot
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Personal qualities of persistence, grit, and adaptability

Compensation and Benefits

* Base salary $65-$75k with an OTE of $130k - $140k and uncapped earning potential
* Equity in the company
* Medical (PPO, HMO, HDHP), dental and vision
* FSA administration
* Life Insurance
* Short/long term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Commuter benefits
* 401K

jobs.title: Inventory & Client Services Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**

Borg Trucking, Inc. is a family-owned business specializing in white-glove receiving, storage, delivery, and installation services for interior designers, furniture showrooms, and residential design projects throughout the San Francisco Bay Area.

We work with designers and their vendors to coordinate the logistics behind furnishing homes and other spaces, from receiving and inspecting individual pieces to storing, tracking, and delivering entire projects.

We're a small, hardworking team operating out of multiple warehouse facilities in South San Francisco. Our work is detail-driven, fast-paced, and constantly changing. We take pride in providing reliable, personalized service and maintaining strong relationships with our clients.

**About the Position**

We're seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, and proactive **Inventory & Client Services Coordinator** to help manage daily inventory operations and client communication.

This position serves as an important connection between our office, warehouse and clients. You'll be responsible for ensuring merchandise is accurately documented, inventory records are current and client requests are handled promptly,

We're looking for someone who takes ownership of their work, follows through on details, communicates effectively, and can manage competing priorities without constant supervision.

This is primarily an office-based position, but it requires regular interaction with our warehouse team and occasional hands-on involvement in warehouse operations.

Key Responsibilities

**Inventory Management & Receiving**

* Process and accurately enter incoming furniture, lighting, rugs, artwork, accessories, and other merchandise into our inventory management system.
* Review packing slips, purchase orders, bills of lading, and receiving documentation to verify shipment details.
* Match merchandise to the correct client, project, vendor, and item description.
* Review inspection photographs and condition reports for completeness and accuracy.
* Identify and document damages, shortages, incorrect merchandise, and discrepancies.
* Maintain accurate inventory records, including item descriptions, quantities, dimensions, condition notes, and warehouse locations.
* Track merchandise across multiple warehouses and storage areas.
* Work with warehouse staff to resolve missing information, unidentified merchandise, and receiving discrepancies.
* Monitor outstanding receiving tasks and ensure incoming inventory is processed in a timely manner.

**Client Services & Communication**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for interior designers and clients regarding inventory and warehouse requests.
* Respond promptly and professionally to client emails, requests, and questions.
* Send receiving confirmations, inspection reports, damage notifications, and inventory updates.
* Research and resolve inquiries regarding missing merchandise, status and discrepancies,
* Communicate with vendors and clients regarding damaged merchandise, returns, and replacement items.
* Maintain organized client correspondence and project records.
* Proactively follow up on outstanding issues to ensure they are resolved.

**Inventory Preparation, Work Orders & Warehouse Coordination**

* Prepare accurate, up-to-date inventory lists for upcoming deliveries, installations, and client pickups.
* Verify that requested merchandise has been received, properly documented, and is available for delivery or pickup.
* Work closely with warehouse staff to identify, locate, and resolve any inventory discrepancies or missing items.
* Prepare and maintain work orders, labor records, and supporting documentation for warehouse services and completed jobs.
* Coordinate client and vendor will-call requests, including preparing pickup lists and working with warehouse staff to ensure merchandise is ready for collection.
* Communicate with clients and vendors regarding merchandise repairs, replacements, returns, and other services to be performed at our warehouse.
* Coordinate with warehouse personnel and outside vendors to facilitate on-site repairs, inspections, and service appointments.
* Track outstanding repairs, returns, and inventory-related issues, following through to ensure they are completed and properly documented.
* Communicate relevant inventory updates, special handling instructions, and project details to the appropriate office and warehouse personnel.
* Review completed work orders and labor records to ensure all services performed are accurately documented for billing purposes.

**Receiving Charges, Storage & Billing Support**

* Review incoming merchandise and assign receiving charges based on established company pricing guidelines.
* Learn and apply our pricing practices for different types of furniture, merchandise, and handling requirements.
* Enter and maintain storage charges and related inventory billing records.
* Identify items requiring special handling, additional labor, or charges outside standard pricing guidelines.
* Verify that receiving, storage, and additional service charges are accurately documented.
* Communicate unusual charges, discrepancies, or pricing questions to management for review.
* Maintain organized supporting records to assist with accurate client invoicing.

*Training will be provided on our pricing structure and billing procedures. These responsibilities will be introduced progressively as familiarity with our operations develops.*

**Office & Operational Support**

* Maintain organized digital records, spreadsheets, client files, and warehouse documentation.
* Collaborate with office and warehouse staff to keep daily operations efficient and organized.
* Assist with tracking outstanding tasks, project updates, returns, and unresolved inventory issues.
* Help reinforce consistent procedures for receiving, inspections, inventory management, and documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve internal processes, organization, and workf

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
About Exponent:

**Exponent** is the only premium engineering and scientific consulting firm with the depth and breadth of expertise to solve our clients’ most profoundly unique, unprecedented, and urgent challenges.

We are committed to engaging multidisciplinary teams of science, engineering, and regulatory experts to empower our clients with solutions that create a safer, healthier, more sustainable world. For over five decades, we've connected the lessons of past failures with tomorrow's solutions to advise clients as they innovate technologically complex products and processes, ensure the safety and health of their users, and address the challenges of sustainability.

Join our team of experts with degrees from top programs at over 500 universities and extensive experience spanning a variety of industries. At Exponent, you’ll contribute to the diverse pool of ideas, talents, backgrounds, and experiences that drives our collaborative teamwork and breakthrough insights. Plus, we help you grow your career through mentoring, sponsorship, and a culture of learning. Thanks for your interest in joining our team!

**Key statistics:**

* 1,100+ Team members
* 950+ Consultants
* 640+ Ph.D.s
* 90+ Disciplines
* 30+ Offices globally

Our Opportunity:

Exponent is a leading engineering and scientific consulting firm whose multidisciplinary experts bring together deep technical knowledge, rigorous analysis, and clear communication to solve some of the most complex challenges facing businesses, insurers, law firms, and government agencies. We are seeking an exceptional **Executive Assistant** to join our team in **Menlo Park, CA**.

This is a unique opportunity for a highly capable, proactive, and polished professional who thrives in a fast-paced, intellectually dynamic environment and takes pride in enabling senior leaders to operate at the highest level. In this role, you will provide high-level administrative support primarily to Exponent’s CEO, President, and General Counsel, while also supporting other co-located members of the executive team, including the Chief Human Resources Officer and Chief Financial Officer. You will play a central role in helping the Executive Office run smoothly and effectively, serving as a trusted liaison between executives and internal staff, clients, board members, analysts, shareholders, and the general public. This is a **full-time, in-office position**, requiring a strong on-site presence to support the daily operations of the Executive Office.

The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, detail-oriented, and resourceful, with the judgment and professionalism to manage sensitive matters with discretion and confidence. This individual understands how to anticipate needs, protect executive time, drive follow-through, and use modern tools—including AI-enabled technologies—to enhance efficiency, responsiveness, and quality of support.

You will be responsible for:

* Manage complex calendars for the CEO, President, and other designated executives, including coordinating meetings with internal and external stakeholders and exercising strong judgment in prioritizing requests, resolving conflicts, and protecting executive time
* Proactively prepare executives for meetings by confirming agendas and objectives, gathering and organizing briefing materials, packaging pre-read documents, and ensuring follow-up items are tracked through completion
* Prepare, edit, and maintain accuracy in reports, presentations, exhibits, correspondence, and other deliverables with a high degree of professionalism, polish, and attention to detail
* Arrange domestic and international travel logistics, including itineraries, accommodations, ground transportation, meeting schedules, and supporting materials to ensure seamless execution
* Support special administrative projects for the CEO, President, General Counsel, Chief Human Resources Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and other members of the executive team, as needed
* Maintain detailed project documentation, including project plans, status reports, tracking spreadsheets, and other records using Microsoft Excel and related tools
* Coordinate and facilitate communications across multiple internal teams and departments, including helping triage urgent matters, approvals, requests for input, legal and compliance-related follow-up items, and general updates
* Support the General Counsel and legal team with litigation-related administrative coordination, including litigation holds, subpoena responses, claims reporting to insurance carriers, document collection and production logistics, information gathering, deadline tracking, and coordination with internal stakeholders and outside counsel
* Organize and support the day-to-day activities of the Executive Office, including handling sensitive executive and legal requests, managing logistics, and helping create a smooth and efficient operating environment
* Assist with expense reporting, travel approvals, filing systems, contact management, signature coordination, budget tracking and outside counsel invoices, and other administrative processes requiring accuracy, discretion, and sound judgment
* Use approved modern productivity tools, including AI-enabled technologies, to support document preparation, organize information, improve workflows, improve responsiveness, and improve the overall quality and efficiency of executive support, consistent with Exponent’s confidentiality, privilege, information security, and data handling requirements
* Assist with planning and coordination of professional and social events, offsites, and other executive activities, as needed
* Welcome visitors, candidates, and other guests to the Executive Office and help create a highly professional first impression for internal and external stakeholders
* Attend selected staff meetings or executive meetings, as appropriate, to document action items, support follow-through, and help maintain momentum on key priorities
*

jobs.title: Program Specialist, After School Programming (P/T, M-F 2:30-6pm) (F/T Summer HRS)
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Salvation Army is a faith-based organization and the largest non-profit provider of social services in the United States. The Salvation Army Brooklyn Brownsville Corps provides church services, food pantry, day care, and after school programming.

Under the direct supervision of the Middle School Program Director and the Corps Officers, the Program Specialist will run daily activities in the middle school-aged programming including but not limited to: homework help, serving meals and snacks, sports, music and arts, arts and crafts, creative arts, off-site field trips, and general day to day supervision of the children.

In addition, the Program Specialist will perform administrative duties, including but not limited to: record keeping, statistics, enrollment paperwork, food service documentation, grant funding paperwork, and other responsibilities as assigned.

The Program Specialist will be required to provide support to the Program Director. The Program Specialist should be experienced and qualified to assume greater leadership responsibility, in absence of the Program Director, when necessary.

During the school year, September-June, the position will be Monday through Friday from 2-6pm. For the seven weeks of summer break, the position will transition to a full day to accommodate summer day camp, for a total of 35 hours per week.

This position is in-person with required regional travel for field trips with children.

Responsibilities:

* Involvement in the total program with willingness to help in all areas as needed, including the classroom, dining room, outdoor/indoor activities, daily assembly.
* Promote observance of the moral and ethical code affecting children and staff.
* Completing Orientation Sessions and attending all parent meetings.
* Attend and contribute to Program Leadership Meetings.
* Help plan and conduct General Staff Meetings.
* Sharing with the Program Director and/or Corps Officers all matters of mutual concern relating to the total welfare of the Middle School Program.
* Complete a Debrief at the end of the school year & summer camp session to include areas of concern for the following program year.
* Assist with Corps programming as directed by Program Director and Corps Officers.
* Assist and support other activities as needed or instructed by the Corps Officers, such Seasonal Programs (Back- to-school supply drive, toy drive, coat drive, etc.) as required.
* Assists Program Director in advancing the mission of The Salvation Army by identifying children and families in need of additional services and connecting them to the Corps Officers.
* Serve as a positive role model.
* Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

* High School Diploma or equivalent; Associates Degree preferred.
* At least 3 Years of Experience in Youth or Camp Programming and the ability to teach and enthuse others preferred.
* *Willingness and comfortability leading students and families in devotions from the Bible preferred, but not required.*
* High energy, enthusiasm and a love of working with children.
* Strong writing and verbal communication skills are required.
* Professional demeanor and strong interpersonal skills.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Attention to detail and follow through.
* Critical thinking and decision-making skills, displaying good judgement and ability to complete work independently.
* Collaborative attitude and ability to work with others in a team environment.
* Ability to communicate and work with groups of various ages and skill levels and provide necessary instruction to program participants and/or staff.
* Comfort working with children with behavioral challenges, and learning differences, etc
* Leadership experience with peers **and** experience in leadership of organized/specialized programming
* Current CPR & First Aid Certifications, or willingness to become certified.
* Physical ability to respond appropriately and quickly to situations requiring first aid.
* Available to work part-time hours on School Days and full-time hours on Non-School Days (School Holidays & Summer)
* Driver’s license preferable

Account Coordinator, Executive & Brand Strategy

New York, NY (Hybrid, 2-3 in office)

Director

1-2 years of experience

Through our four divisions – Executive + Brand Strategy, Production, and Strategic Communications - we forecast trends, identify key moments, and capture the public’s interest to bring our clients’ ideas to life.

The ideal candidate brings 1–2 years of experience in an agency, brand, or client-service setting. You move fast while remaining thoughtful about details, balance structure with creative curiosity, and take full ownership of your responsibilities.

As you implement a seamless operational flow for the team, you will expand your role into concept development, research, and creative brainstorming across client campaigns, launches, and positioning.

Please apply through LinkedIn. No phone calls please.
