jobs.description:
We invite you to review our current business services professionals openings to learn about the opportunities available across the firm.

**About Us**

Skadden, Arps, Slate, Meagher & Flom LLP has forged a reputation as one of the most prestigious law firms in the world. Relying on innovation, intellect, teamwork and tenacity, our lawyers deliver the highest quality advice and novel solutions to our clients’ legal issues. We are known for handling the most complex transactions, litigation/controversy issues, and regulatory matters, as well as for the strong partnerships we build with clients and each other. Our attorneys, who reflect a broad range of experiences and perspectives, work together seamlessly across 50-plus practices and 21 offices in the world’s major financial centers.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking a **Legal Technology Administrative Coordinator** to join our Firm. This position will be based in our New York office (hybrid). The Legal Technology Administrative Coordinator provides high-level coordination and administrative assistance to Legal Technology management teams. Assists with other high-level, complex tasks and projects, while collaborating with other Firm departments and team members. Serves as a resource to department personnel by demonstrating excellent customer service when responding to inquiries regarding department procedures. Includes (but not limited to) the following essential functions:

  

* Assists Legal Technology management team with preparing and tracking training initiatives for new hires and continuing education programs for all team members.
* Manages data on cloud-hosted platforms, ensuring that data is archived or retired under Firm retention policies once it is no longer needed.
* Coordinates department vendor contract and license renewals, tracking renewal dates and confirming license counts.
* Assists with tracking and obtaining approvals for department related invoices and assisting with budget planning related to vendor costs.
* Assists with matter mobility, creating spreadsheets to track data being transferred in and out of the Firm.
* Creates and maintains reports related to legal holds and legal hold members.
* Maintains Legal Technology, Information Governance and Records Management intranet sites ensuring that the documentation is current and updated when applications change.

Researchers at Johns Hopkins University conduct clinical trials and clinical studies to discover new ways to prevent and treat diseases and other health problems. We are seeking a ***Clinical Research Coordinator*** who will administratively coordinate clinical protocol implementation, typically for a single study. Will ensure efficient logistical implementation of the study activities and provide administrative support for research-related regulatory issues.

  
  

The Center for Latino Adolescent and Family Health (CLAFH) at the Johns Hopkins School of Nursing seeks a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) to serve as a Clinical Research Coordinator, overseeing the daily implementation of community-based behavioral health and prevention programs serving adolescents, young adults, and families in the South Bronx. This position requires an active New York State LPN license and combines field-based program leadership, staff supervision, and clinical responsibilities within the scope of LPN licensure.

  
  

**Specific Duties & Responsibilities**

* Coordinate all activities of a clinical research study to ensure adherence to protocol and validity of findings.
* Participate in clinical study start-up meetings.
* Assist research nurses, study coordinators, principal investigators, and other study personnel in executing protocol-related activities.
* Explain the study background and rationale for the research to potential and current participants
* Contribute to the development of recruitment strategies for participants for assigned study.
* Implement a variety of techniques for recruitment as appropriate, e.g., print and web-based advertisements, contact referring physicians, participate in community events, etc.
* Independently conduct the consenting process or ensure consent is obtained on appropriate participants.
* Schedule participants for required activities and provide any special instructions prior to upcoming tests/exams.
* Serve as liaison to study participants.
* Assist with setup of the data collection system and enter and organize data.
* Assist in coordinating study meetings.
* Participate in study meetings and provide updates on protocol implementation status and make recommendations on operational issues.
* Assist with the preparation of submissions to the Institutional Review Board (IRB)
* Liaison with IRB on administrative matters and facilitate communications with the PI.
* Conduct literature searches to provide background information.
* Obtain and maintain excellent operating knowledge of assigned clinical protocol, clinical equipment, and clinical computer systems.
* Oversee budget expenditures for study operations.
* Other duties as assigned.
  

  

*In addition to the duties described above*

* Oversee daily field operations of community-based health and prevention programs, including home visits, community outreach, health screenings, prevention education, and referral and linkage to services.
* Coordinate and supervise field-based research and program staff, including community health workers and family coaches, and manage staff schedules, assignments, training, and program implementation activities.
* Perform clinical duties within the scope of LPN licensure, including health screenings, patient education, clinical documentation, and nursing services under appropriate clinical supervision.
* Oversee participant recruitment, enrollment, retention, and follow-up, ensuring fidelity to evidence-based intervention protocols and compliance with program requirements.

* Current, active, and unrestricted Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) license in New York State. LPN licensure is a mandatory requirement for this position.

With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

New York, NY

Job Title: **Associate Manager, Production and Account Management, Revenue Marketing**

Reports to: Executive Director, US Production and Account Management, Revenue Marketing

Location: New York, NY

  

Condé Nast is a world-renowned media company, producing the highest quality content for the most influential audiences through iconic brands that touch upon every consumer passion point. Our Revenue Marketing department is responsible for harnessing that power and passion to create and execute the industry’s most compelling programs, initiatives and partnerships.

  

The Production & Account Management (P&A) team is responsible for the execution of custom marketing programs across all Condé Nast brands and sales categories, collaborating with the sales, digital operations, insights/research, creative, experiential, video and PR teams to produce content programs that include white label, branded content, custom video, native articles, events, social/digital-first content and more.

  

This position is on the Production & Account Management team, supporting the activation process to help bring co-branded marketing programs to life across Condé Nast Traveler, Bon Appetit and Architectural Digest. We're looking for an organized and adaptable marketer who's eager to grow their skills in client services and communication. Additionally, this person will learn and execute small scale campaigns, help identify day-to-day program needs and support optimizations while assisting on large-scale programs. We're looking for someone who's a quick learner, detail-oriented, and excited to build a foundation in the rapidly evolving media and marketing industry — someone naturally collaborative and proactive.

**Responsibilities include:**

* Support the planning, management, and execution of branded content marketing programs, including content creation, event activations, influencer programs, social campaigns, print units, and more
* Assist with client and agency communication while working in tandem with internal partners
* Help identify potential campaign and program hurdles and flag opportunities for real-time optimization
* Support program budget tracking, timeline management, and content/talent agreement coordination
* Build relationships with clients, production partners, and internal teams
* Stay up to date on industry and media trends to help surface new partnership ideas and/or workflow efficiencies

**Requirements:**

* 0-1+ years of experience or internship experience in branded content creation, publishing, digital media, or relevant brand marketing; client services experience a plus
* Interest in brand marketing, client management, or production is a plus
* Coursework, internship, or project experience creating branded content, specifically video and digital content, preferred
* Strong social and interpersonal communication skills are a must
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a high-volume, fast-paced environment with effective time management skills
* Ability to quickly learn and navigate internal processes, procedures, and content management systems
* Strong attention to detail; comfort with Google Docs and trackers
* Self-starter who can work independently and within a team setting
* Positive, creative, solutions-oriented, and client-focused
Experience with Google Slides/Suite preferred, but not required  

The expected base salary range for this position is from $65,000-$75,000 . Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including but not limited to relevant skills, training, experience, and education.

  

In addition to salary and a generous employee benefits package, successful candidates may also be eligible to receive discretionary bonus compensation.

**What happens next?**
======================

If you are interested in this opportunity, please apply, and we will review your application as soon as possible. You can update your resume or upload a cover letter at any time by accessing your candidate profile.

***Condé Nast is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, age, familial status and other legally protected characteristics.***

jobs.title: Client Service Associate, Executive Benefits Account Management
jobs.description:
Posting Description:

**Who We Are:**
---------------

NFP, an Aon company, is a multiple Best Places to Work award winner in Business Insurance. We are an organization of consultative advisors and problem solvers. We help companies and individuals around the globe address their most significant risk, workforce, wealth management and retirement challenges through custom solutions and a people-first approach. To learn more, please visit: https://www.NFP.com.

Covala Group (part of NFP, an Aon company) is a proven enroller and administrator of voluntary, supplemental and individual disability benefits for large employers. Since 1993 we have connected employees of our clients to over $4.5 billion of income protection. We have also assisted Fortune 500 companies in the development and implementation of group life insurance, corporate owned life insurance, and long-term care programs. Our name, Covala, was inspired by the covalent bond, the strongest type of chemical bond there is. Covala embodies our dedication to forming powerful bonds with our clients and plan participants — connecting them to the benefits they need and the service they deserve.

**Position Summary:**
---------------------

The Account Management position is an integral part of a ten-person team. The role is central within the organization and is responsible for managing relationships with corporate clients and overseeing internal operations among different functional groups.The individual in this position will participate in company-wide projects that involve collaboration across departments. This is an excellent opportunity for someone seeking to contribute meaningfully to a growing business and gain valuable experience. Success in this role requires a proactive and results-driven mindset, strong interpersonal and communication skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams. Intellectual curiosity, adaptability in a dynamic environment, and professional integrity are also essential qualities.

**Schedule:**
-------------

This full-time, exempt position follows a standard schedule of Monday through Friday, 8:30 a.m. to 5:30 p.m. Eastern Time. The role is open to a hybrid arrangement from our New York City office or a fully remote arrangement within the United States.

Hybrid employees may work onsite up to three days per week during the first three months for training, with ongoing attendance based on business needs thereafter. Remote employees must maintain the established Eastern Time schedule, along with a private, confidential workspace and reliable high-speed internet.

**Position Responsibilities:**
------------------------------

Essential Functions:

* Interact daily with Benefit / Human Resource contacts at large corporate clients and top law firms providing administration and client service support for their individual disability insurance benefits.
* Coordinate annual enrollment and communication campaigns to executives of our corporate clients.
* Analyze census data from our corporate clients and determine eligible executive populations for enrollment campaigns.
* Handle inquiries from eligible executives about the disability insurance being offered through our enrollments.
* Team with our IT Group to develop reports for our corporate clients.

**Qualifications:**
-------------------

The ideal candidate will demonstrate:

* Strong attention to detail with a high level of accountability and ownership.
* Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to prioritize multiple responsibilities and meet deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate professionally with clients, HR and Benefits contacts, executives, plan participants, and internal partners.
* Resourcefulness and sound judgment, including knowing when to engage others to resolve questions or issues.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, fast-paced team.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, with particular comfort reviewing and working with data in Excel.
* A professional, client-focused approach and the ability to adapt to changing priorities.

**Education/Experience:**
-------------------------

* High School Diploma or GED required; Bachelor’s Degree preferred.
* Life and Health Insurance License required.
* Able to obtain Long-Term Care (LTC) certification within three months of hire.
* 5-10 years of relevant experience in client service, account management, insurance, or employee benefits required.
* Executive benefits, individual disability insurance, and/or enrollment program experience preferred.

**What We Offer:**
------------------

We’re proud to offer a competitive salary, PTO & paid holidays, 401(k) with match, exclusive discount programs, health & wellness programs, and more. Our PeopleFirst culture focuses on building and nurturing lifelong relationships with our employees because, at the end of the day, we exist to be there for others. The base salary range for this position is $61,500 – $80,000. The base salary offered will be determined by factors including, but not limited to, experience, credentials, education, certifications, skill level required for the position, the scope of the position, and geographic location. Actual base salary offered will be determined on a case-by-case basis. In addition to the base salary, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

***NFP and You… Better Together!***

NFP and Covala Group is an inclusive Equal Employment Opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
**ABOUT MINERVA**
-----------------

Minerva builds AI for marketing leaders. We work together with marketers to automate and accelerate their workflows with AI agents. Our agents augment the end-to-end workflow of the marketer by automating analysis, campaign planning, activation, measurement and reporting.

Customers like the NBA, Ramp, Wander, Hard Rock Stadium Group and Luxury Presence use Minerva to develop a better understanding of their customers and introduce AI specifically built to understand the customer into their commercial organizations. Our campaigns outperform other tools because we built the entire stack: from identity to enrichment to data integration as well as agents to action and report on the analysis.

We've raised $20M from The General Partnership, 8VC, Lingotto, NBA Investments, Topology Ventures, Future Positive, Background Capital and many others. Our team brings together operators and investors from Citadel, Dentsu, Bridgewater, Meta Superintelligence, Growthloop, Amazon and Lazard, alongside engineers and researchers from Berkeley, MIT, Stanford and Cambridge.

**THE ROLE**
------------

We're growing fast across New York and several countries, and every new person, vendor and candidate runs through operations. You keep that machine running and make it run better every month.

This is a generalist seat on a small operations team. You'll run the processes that touch everyone at Minerva: access and equipment, vendors and contracts, and the written procedures behind all of it. You'll also run the logistics for new-hire onboarding and interview scheduling, with our Head of Ecosystem, who owns the new-hire experience and our recruiting process. You'll work next to an engineer whose job is to automate this work, so part of your job is showing them what to automate next.

You report to our COO.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**
------------------

* **Keep access and devices in order.** Who has which tool, and who doesn't anymore, tracked well enough to hand to an auditor.
* **Run onboarding and offboarding logistics.** Accounts, equipment and background checks for hires in New York and abroad, so every first day starts ready.
* **Keep interviews moving.** Schedule loops and chase feedback, so no candidate waits on us.
* **Manage vendors and renewals.** Track contracts and renewal dates, run the intake for new tools, and chase what's overdue.
* **Write the playbook.** Every recurring process gets a documented, current procedure someone else could follow.
* **Find the next thing to automate.** You'll know which steps waste the most time, because you're the one doing them.

**WHAT YOU HAVE**
-----------------

* 1–3 years in operations, people operations, recruiting coordination, office or business operations, ideally at a startup or another fast, scrappy team.
* You finish things. Nothing you own falls through.
* You're organized enough that a process you run is easy to audit and easy to hand off.
* You write clearly and keep people informed without being asked.
* You use AI tools in your own work every day and you're curious about doing more with them.
* Discretion with personal and candidate information.
* You're in New York City or willing to relocate.

**YOU MIGHT BE A FIT IF YOU ARE…**
----------------------------------

* A recruiting coordinator who wants a bigger operations seat.
* An operations or office lead at a small company who did a bit of everything.
* An analyst or consultant who'd rather run things than recommend them.
* Or you don't fit any of these neatly, but you've made a messy process run well. Apply.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**
---------------------------

* **First 90 days:** every new hire's first day is set up before they arrive, every interview loop has its feedback in on time, and the access list is current.
* **First 6 months:** the recurring processes you run are all written down, and at least three of them have been automated with the engineer, on your recommendation.

**COMPENSATION**
----------------

$95,000–$121,000 base salary, depending on experience. Equity. Medical, dental and vision.

**HOW TO APPLY**
----------------

Skip the cover letter. Tell us about a messy, recurring process you took over and made run better: what was broken, what you changed and what it looked like a month later. A few paragraphs.

**WHERE WE WORK**
-----------------

We work in person from our office at 300 Kent Avenue in Williamsburg, Brooklyn.

**BENEFITS**
------------

Every full-time role includes equity; medical, dental and vision coverage; unlimited PTO; a monthly fitness stipend; and an annual company offsite. We'd rather pay people well than buy perks nobody uses.

**PAY TRANSPARENCY**
--------------------

The salary range in this posting is our good-faith range for the role in New York City at the time of posting. Where an offer lands depends on the level and experience we see in the interview process.

**APPLYING**
------------

Apply on this page. We don't take applications by email, and we don't accept unsolicited submissions from recruiting agencies. If you need an accommodation at any point in the process, write to hiring@minerva.io.

**WORK AUTHORIZATION**
----------------------

You'll need to be authorized to work in the United States. We consider visa sponsorship case by case, so tell us on the application if you'll need it.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY**
---------------------

Minerva is an equal opportunity employer. We make hiring decisions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, citizenship status, age, disability, marital status, veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, New York State or New York City law.

jobs.title: Technical Operations Associate, Site Services
jobs.description:
The Technical Operations Associate supports day-to-day service coordination, reporting, documentation, scheduling, asset management, and technology operations. This role ensures operational tasks are completed accurately and on time while providing responsive service to internal stakeholders and business users.

Working closely with technology teams and support personnel, the associate coordinates service requests, monitors device compliance, maintains accurate records, and follows tasks through completion. The ideal candidate is organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing recurring responsibilities and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Review, manage, and prioritize incidents, service requests, projects, and operational tasks within ServiceNow.
* Monitor assigned queues, aging tickets, pending customer responses, and overdue updates to support timely resolution within established service levels.
* Prepare daily operational reports and end-of-day summaries covering completed work, outstanding items, project updates, priorities, escalations, risks, and blockers.
* Coordinate schedules, recurring meetings, reminders, maintenance windows, and follow-up activities.
* Monitor endpoint compliance, device health, and update status using Microsoft Intune and related management platforms.
* Maintain accurate ticket notes, status updates, troubleshooting records, and resolution documentation.
* Create and update operational procedures, knowledge articles, service documentation, and SharePoint content.
* Coordinate workstation deployments, equipment provisioning, hardware replacements, technology refreshes, and device lifecycle activities.
* Maintain inventory and asset records, track equipment, and support audit reviews.
* Coordinate operating system updates, software deployments, device maintenance, and scheduled support activities.
* Create and maintain ServiceNow tickets for recurring work, maintenance activities, and operational initiatives.
* Partner with internal teams to ensure work is appropriately assigned, tracked, and completed.
* Communicate service status, scheduling changes, and operational updates to stakeholders.
* Support projects, ad hoc requests, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive business information.
* Perform additional duties as assigned.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Experience using ServiceNow or a similar service management platform to track incidents, requests, projects, and operational workflows.
* Familiarity with Microsoft Intune, Microsoft 365, Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint administration and support functions.
* Working knowledge of IT Service Management principles, ticket lifecycle management, and operational support practices.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, including managing multiple priorities, recurring tasks, and deadlines.
* Experience coordinating schedules, meetings, maintenance activities, and operational follow-up.
* Ability to prepare accurate reports, dashboards, status updates, and operational records.
* Strong documentation skills, including maintaining knowledge articles, procedures, and SharePoint content.
* Experience supporting inventory management, asset tracking, equipment lifecycle activities, and technology refreshes.
* Ability to identify service issues, operational risks, and process gaps and escalate concerns appropriately.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong problem-solving, critical-thinking, and follow-through skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across teams.
* Customer-focused approach with attention to accuracy, professionalism, and confidentiality.
* Adaptability to changing priorities and business requirements.

**Attributes That Drive Success**

* Self-motivated, organized, and detail-oriented.
* Proactive communication and consistent follow-through.
* Ownership of assigned tasks through completion.
* Ability to prioritize effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong collaboration and stakeholder coordination.

Salary: $50,000 - $70,000

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

* **Reports to:** Head of Growth Marketing
* **Location:** New York City office - 10-20% onsite/hybrid
* **Hours/Status:** Full-Time, exempt
* **Salary (USD):** $95,000-$110,000

**The role**  
  
Spektrix has an exciting opportunity for a Digital Marketing Manager to join our team!  
  
As the Digital Marketing Manager, you'll execute, measure, and optimize Spektrix’s digital marketing activity across campaigns, channels, and audiences. Working closely with Growth Marketing, Content & Campaigns, Client Marketing, Product & Partner Marketing, Events, and the Website team, you'll turn marketing strategies into targeted, measurable digital experiences that generate demand, engage clients, and move audiences to action.

You should be comfortable moving between building a campaign, defining an audience segment, reviewing conversion performance, testing an approach, and identifying what should change next.  
  
If you bring both strong execution and an analytical mindset to everything you build, we want to hear from you!

### **What You'll Do**

**Campaign Execution & Delivery:** Translate strategy briefs into end-to-end digital channel plans, automating nurture journeys, client/partner communications, product launches, and event promotions.

**Paid & Digital Channel Management:** Build, run, and optimize paid digital and social activity aligned with the growth strategy established by the Head of Growth Marketing.

**Audience Segmentation & Data Quality:** Manage audience targeting and CRM data hygiene to deliver tailored, relevant messaging and high-quality campaign builds.

**Performance Analysis, Testing & Optimization:** Implement robust tracking and attribution, lead continuous A/B testing (messaging, channels, landing pages), and use data-driven insights to refine future strategies rather than just reporting past metrics.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Website, Content, and Growth colleagues to build conversion journeys, distribute content effectively, and support co-marketing initiatives.

**Quality Assurance & Project Management:** Balance multiple concurrent projects, maintaining strict QA standards across brand consistency, accessibility, tracking, and timely delivery.

### **What You Bring**

  

* Demonstrated experience in digital marketing, demand generation, growth marketing, or a related role, ideally within a B2B environment.
* Hands-on experience building and executing multi-channel digital marketing campaigns.
* Strong working knowledge of email marketing, marketing automation, audience segmentation, and nurture journeys.
* Experience managing or executing paid digital campaigns, including paid social.
* Experience with campaign tracking, analytics, attribution, and performance reporting.
* Ability to interpret marketing data, identify meaningful insights, and translate those insights into specific actions and optimizations.
* Experience with CRM and marketing automation platforms and an understanding of how campaign, contact, and engagement data flow between systems.
* Understanding of conversion optimization and testing methodologies.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly when managing campaign setup, segmentation, tracking, links, and communications.
* Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple campaigns and deadlines simultaneously.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, including content, design, web, product marketing, client marketing, events, and sales.
* Strong judgment and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify gaps, question assumptions, and recommend improvements rather than relying solely on established processes.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of outcomes, and proactively identify what needs to happen next.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Company paid medical, dental and vision insurance
* Generous Paid Time Off benefits, including
  + 21 days of PTO (vacation, personal time, whatever you choose to use it for)
  + 14 paid holidays
  + 10 Paid Sick Days
* 401(k) with 4% employer match
* Two paid volunteering days per year
* Professional development opportunities
* Flexible working with support for WFH setup and equipment
* Month-long Paid Sabbatical after 5 years of service
* Free snacks, drinks and breakfast items in our offices
* Varied range of regular social activities throughout the year

**Working From Home**  
While many Spektrix team members live near one of our offices (NYC, London, or Manchester), remote/non-local team members work from home *most* of the time, and all team members work from home at least *some* of the time!  
  
We provide reasonable support and all the hardware you need to get started, but we do require that you have the have the following in place to work from home:

* A quiet working space at home where you can consistently take video calls without interruption
* A strong, reliable internet connection that supports your participation in video calls and access to our systems and service

**Working At The Office**  
For team members who are 'local' to NYC, a stipend is offered for each day you work on-site. Think of it as our way of easing potential commute related costs (but no need to prove it - this is a perk we offer for days worked onsite, regardless of how you choose to get there).  
  
**Equal Opportunities**  
Spektrix is an equal opportunity employer. We recruit regardless of race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age or disability status and look to employ from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.  
  
Spektrix is committed to creating an inclusive work environment, where our team members are supported in expressing themselves and delivering their best work. So, however you identify and whatever background you bring with you, please apply if this is a role that would make you excited to come into work every day.

jobs.title: Creator Community Manager, VETTE
jobs.description:
Condé Nast is one of the world's most renowned media publishing companies, creating and distributing every type of media today, spanning print and digital publishing in all formats. With a portfolio of some of today's most influential brands, the company continues to grow its audience through a global operational and content infrastructure across its 12 owned and operated markets. Headquartered in New York City, the company's owned and operated markets include China, France, Germany, India, Italy, Japan, Mexico & Latin America, Spain, Taiwan, UAE/Dubai, the U.K., and the U.S., with additional local license partners in over twenty additional markets across the globe. Lead brands include Vogue, The New Yorker, GQ, Architectural Digest, Condé Nast Traveler, Vanity Fair, Wired, Allure, Ars Technica, Bon Appétit, House & Garden, Pitchfork, Tatler, and Vogue Business.

**Job Description**
===================

Location:

New York, NY

**Overview**  
The Creator Community Manager will be responsible for the day-to-day success and engagement of VETTE creators.

  

You will build strong relationships with our creator community, helping creators get the most out of VETTE, keeping them engaged and active, and ensuring their storefronts remain fresh, relevant and commercially successful.

  

You will also play a key role in building the broader VETTE creator program, from community programming and creator education to events, content creation, social strategy and new initiatives.

  

This is a highly relationship-driven and hands-on role. We are looking for someone who understands creators, has excellent taste and judgment, is highly organized, and knows how to motivate talent without making the relationship feel transactional.

  

**Primary Responsibilities**  
*Creator Management & Success*

* Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of VETTE creators, acting as a trusted point of contact throughout their journey.
* Help creators develop and maintain strong, distinctive storefronts that reflect their individual point of view.
* Drive consistent creator activity across storefront merchandising, editorial content and social promotion.
* Work closely with creators to develop sustainable content franchises and publishing rhythms.
* Identify when creators are becoming less active and proactively develop plans to re-engage them.
* Monitor creator performance and translate data into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Surface relevant brands, products, trends and commercial opportunities for individual creators.
Partner with internal merchandising, product, design and commercial teams to resolve creator needs and opportunities.  

  

*Creator Community & Programming*

* Help build the VETTE creator community from the ground up, creating a network creators genuinely value being part of.
* Develop and manage VETTE’s creator community programming, including creator conversations, office hours, workshops and educational initiatives across commerce, merchandising, content, audience development and the VETTE platform.
Create opportunities for creators to learn from and connect with one another, while supporting creator advisory groups, product beta programs and ongoing feedback initiatives that help shape the VETTE experience.  

  

*Creator Events & Experiences*

* Help develop and execute VETTE creator events, from intimate dinners to workshops, Fashion Week moments and larger community experiences.
* Work across Condé Nast and with external partners to identify relevant opportunities for the VETTE creator community.
Ensure every creator touchpoint feels thoughtful, premium and consistent with the VETTE brand.  

  

*Social, Content & Creative Production*

* Support the development and execution of VETTE’s social strategy, with a particular focus on showcasing our creators, their storefronts and their point of view.
* Identify creator stories, launches, edits, cultural moments and trends that can translate into compelling VETTE social content.
* Concept, create and produce social-first content across VETTE channels, with a strong understanding of what works across Instagram, TikTok and emerging platforms.
* Own hands-on content creation when needed, including filming creators, capturing behind-the-scenes and event content, conducting informal interviews and creating quick-turn social assets.
* Develop creative concepts, formats and recurring social franchises that build VETTE’s identity and make our creator community culturally relevant and engaging.
* Produce content shoots from concept through execution, including developing creative briefs, shot lists, schedules and talent requirements, and coordinating photographers, videographers, editors and other external creative partners where needed.
* Coordinate creator participation in VETTE-owned content, campaigns, shoots and social moments.
* Manage VETTE’s social media channels and day-to-day publishing in alignment with the broader platform marketing strategy.
Partner with internal and external creative teams on larger-scale content production while being comfortable executing content independently and at speed.  

  

*Building the Program*

* Help develop the systems, playbooks and processes required to scale the VETTE creator program.
* Maintain creator calendars, activity plans and success plans.
* Track creator engagement, storefront activity and community health.
* Collect creator feedback and identify recurring themes for the product and wider VETTE team.
* Test new community initiatives, measure what works and continuously improve the creator experience.

* Coordinate daily bakery preparation activities and production schedules.
* Communicate production requirements and deadlines to relevant kitchen team members.
* Monitor ingredient inventory, including flour, yeast, sugar, dairy products, and other baking supplies.
* Assist with ordering ingredients and coordinating deliveries with approved suppliers.
* Maintain records of inventory levels, production quantities, waste, and supply usage.
* Help ensure bakery products meet established quality, freshness, and presentation standards.
* Coordinate with chefs, pastry cooks, and restaurant management to support daily service needs.
* Track preparation schedules and communicate potential delays or supply shortages.
* Assist with organizing storage areas and rotating ingredients according to food safety procedures.
* Help maintain accurate production checklists, inventory reports, and operational documentation.
* Support portion control and waste-reduction initiatives.
* Monitor cleanliness and organization in bakery preparation and storage areas.
* Follow applicable food safety, sanitation, allergen-control, and workplace procedures.
* Assist with coordinating seasonal bakery items and special production requests.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflow, resource utilization, and communication.

Qualifications

* High school diploma or equivalent required; additional education in hospitality, culinary arts, or business operations is preferred.
* Previous experience in bakery operations, restaurant administration, food production, or inventory coordination is an advantage.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication abilities.
* Proficiency with spreadsheets, email, and basic inventory or scheduling tools.
* Attention to detail when maintaining records and tracking supplies.
* Ability to coordinate multiple tasks and meet production deadlines.
* Understanding of food handling, storage, and sanitation practices.
* Ability to work collaboratively with kitchen staff, management, and suppliers.

Preferred Skills

* Familiarity with Italian bakery products, breads, pastries, and dessert preparation.

jobs.description:
**GENERAL STATEMENT OF JOB**

Reporting directly to the General Services Director, this position supports developing, managing, and coordinating capital improvement projects, including planning, organizing, bidding and construction administration, and project execution. Monitors capital budgets to ensure project costs stay within the scope of work. Provides administrative support, project coordination, and financial oversight for all aspects of capital construction projects. Assist with preparing construction specifications, bid documents, contracts, and change orders. Enters approved payment applications into the city’s ERP system. Completes field inspection reports and inputs and updates data, documentation, and budget information into the CIP project management platform (Procore).

**SPECIFIC DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

Essential Functions:

Coordinates and prepares facility services and construction specifications, and bid documents. Coordinates pre-bid and pre-construction conferences. Drafts Request for Proposals (RFP) and develop the scope of work.

Coordinates the design and permit process and work of contractors, engineers, architects, design professionals, and other personnel to ensure the efficient and economical use of program funds, personnel, materials, facilities, and time.

Monitors individual project budget summaries assuring expenditures are within approved budget, tracking changes to the contract documents that may result in change orders. Assists with project financial reports, accounting, and grant reimbursement. Prepares project budgets and assists with budget development, as requested by the director. Monitors and ensures all requirements of grants and contracts are met. Prepares complete reports on time with supporting conclusions and recommendations.

Develops and maintains data systems and records to track the progress of each project for proper evaluation, control, and documentation to ensure compliance with City, State, and Federal requirements.

Assures effective communication among consultants, contractors, department heads, and other stakeholders. Communicates project status to staff and other affected groups, keeping building occupants informed as to the progress of projects and of any developing problems, reporting alternative courses of action to mitigate such problems.

Creates presentation materials, authors' written and oral reports, and media materials. Uses speaking engagements, media interviews, and other methods to enhance the community’s awareness of and appreciation for capital projects and to educate community stakeholders regarding each project’s function and objectives.

Coordinates design, specification, and construction meetings.

Performs other related work as required by the director.

**MINIMUM EDUCATION AND TRAINING**

Requires a bachelor’s degree in business administration, engineering, architecture, construction management, construction administration, or a related field, supplemented by three (3) years of experience with project coordination, business operations, or administrative management.

An equivalent combination of education, training, and experience which provides the requisite knowledge, skills, and abilities for this job will also be considered.

Requires a valid state driver’s license with an acceptable driving history.

**MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS AND STANDARDS REQUIRED**

Physical Requirements:

This position classifies the physical exertion requirements has the ability to exert very moderate physical effort in light work, typically involving some combination of stooping, kneeling, crouching, and crawling, and which may involve some lifting, carrying, pushing, and/or pulling of objects and materials of moderate weight (up to 30 pounds). Some tasks require the ability to perceive and discriminate colors or shades of colors, sounds, odor, depth, and visual cues or signals. Some tasks require the ability to communicate orally. Performance of essential functions may require exposure to adverse environmental conditions, such as odors, fumes, temperature and noise extremes, machinery, vibrations, electric currents, traffic hazards, or bright/dim lights.

**Official Classification Summary**

The purpose of this classification is to serve as the office manager and primary administrative support resource for a major division or department.

Administrative Coordinators are broadly responsible for coordinating administrative, operational, financial, procurement, records management, customer service, and departmental support functions. Employees in this classification exercise independent judgment, coordinate multiple work activities, maintain records, process financial and purchasing transactions, support departmental leadership, and serve as liaisons between departments, staff, vendors, and external stakeholders.

Additional duties and responsibilities may be assigned in accordance with the Fulton County Administrative Coordinator I classification specification.

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_

**Essential Functions**

  

Serves as liaison between the assigned department and other departments/divisions, staff members, County officials, the public, community leaders, outside agencies, or other individuals or organizations for the distribution and receipt of routine information; interacts with various officials and dignitaries involving sensitive client relations; conveys information among division/department personnel; circulates documentation to appropriate departments.

Provides administrative/secretarial support for management and/or staff of assigned department/division: relieves management staff of routine administrative tasks; screens telephone calls, mail, e-mail, and other communications and initiates appropriate action/response; records and transcribes dictation; types, composes, edits, or proofreads various documentation; maintains calendars and schedules meetings, appointments, interviews, or other activities; coordinates travel arrangements, accommodations, conference registrations, or related plans for department staff.

Processes documentation pertaining to budget or general financial management; reviews invoices for accuracy, matches with purchase orders; enters budget data into computer; assists with budget preparation; provides budgetary input and assists in forecasting revenues/expenditures; enters daily revenue into computer and generates revenue reports; reviews monthly budget analysis reports; monitors expenditures to ensure compliance with approved budget; processes budget transfers as needed; reconciles payable records with Finance Department records prepares bank deposits; coordinates internal accounting activities; maintains current balances for accounts; and maintains departmental petty cash funds.

Processes purchasing documentation: reviews purchase requisitions and verifies availability of budgeted funds; prepares purchase orders and forwards data to appropriate departments; obtains competitive price quotes; orders materials under blanket purchase orders.; reviews invoices, purchase orders, or other documents for accuracy; research discrepancies, assigns proper accounting/budgetary codes, obtains proper signatures, and forwards for payment; maintains files and records.

Receives and sorts incoming documentation and materials: sends/receives documentation; distributes/delivers incoming faxes, subpoenas, mail, or other documentation to appropriate personnel; sorts, organizes, opens, and/or distributes incoming mail; signs for incoming packages and delivers to appropriate personnel; processes outgoing mail; copies and distributes forms, reports, correspondence, schedules, agendas, or other documentation.  
  
Performs customer service functions in person, by telephone, and by mail: provides information/assistance regarding department/division services, procedures, fees, or other issues; responds to routine questions or complaints; researches problems/complaints and initiates problem resolution; receives payments for various fees, fines, or services: records transactions, posts payments, and issues receipts; balances cash drawers; prepares revenues for deposit and forwards as appropriate.  
  
Provides administrative support for boards, committees, or other meetings: prepares meeting agendas, packets, and related documentation; coordinates meeting rooms/facilities, equipment, and refreshments; notifies participants of scheduled meetings; submits public notices to newspapers, property owners, or others as required; prepares and distributes agendas, meeting notices, meeting packets, and related documentation; records and transcribes meeting minutes; distributes meeting minutes to appropriate individuals; maintains official records.  
  
Maintains department webpage, social media, and online enrollment; uploads pictures, schedules, brochures and other events and information; adds upcoming events to calendar; posts news and announcements; enters and maintains information regarding classes and fees; processes registrations, memberships and rentals; runs reports and prints class lists; assists customers with creating user accounts and site navigation as needed.  
  
Coordinates arrangements for various meetings; notifies participants of scheduled meetings; prepares meeting notices, agendas, and meeting packets; coordinates room reservations, setup, refreshments, and equipment required for meetings; attends meetings; records and/or transcribes meeting minutes; distributes documentation; maintains records.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:
ABOUT ORTHO SPORT & SPINE PHYSICIANS

Ortho Sport & Spine Physicians is a multi-location orthopedic practice serving patients across the United States. We are seeking an organized, proactive Administrative Coordinator to support our team and assist with administrative and project-based activities related to establishing and relocating clinic locations nationwide.

POSITION SUMMARY

The Administrative Coordinator provides day-to-day administrative support, coordinates communications and records, and assists with projects that support clinic openings and relocations. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, adaptable, and comfortable managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Prepare reports, memos, letters, presentations, and other business documents.

Answer incoming calls, direct inquiries, and take accurate messages.

Maintain, file, and retrieve corporate records, documents, and reports.

Assist with meeting preparation, scheduling, and coordination.

Use Microsoft Excel, word-processing, spreadsheet, database, and presentation applications to support team needs.

Review incoming correspondence and submissions and distribute information to appropriate team members.

Coordinate travel arrangements for team members.

Order office supplies and maintain administrative records and databases.

Support virtual coordination and remote administrative activities as needed.

Open, sort, and distribute incoming faxes, emails, and other correspondence.

Provide general administrative and project support, including activities related to new or relocating clinics.

Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

Prior experience as an Administrative Coordinator or in a comparable administrative support role.

Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize daily workload.

Ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced, changing environment.

Proactive problem-solving skills and sound judgment.

Professional written and verbal communication skills.

Bilingual proficiency in English and Spanish is a plus.

EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE

High school diploma or GED required.

Associate degree or higher preferred.

Administrative coordination experience in a fast-paced environment.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Ortho Sport & Spine Physicians is committed to equal employment opportunity and considers qualified applicants without regard to legally protected characteristics.

*Applicants must be authorized to work lawfully in the United States for NCCPA as NCCPA will not sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas.*

As the **Meeting & Events Coordinator**, you’ll play an important role in creating well-organized and engaging meetings and events across NCCPA. You’ll coordinate travel, meeting logistics, vendor relationships, communications, and event details while supporting Board and committee meetings, conferences, summits, and other strategic events. From planning through execution, you’ll help ensure each event runs smoothly and provides a positive experience for participants and stakeholders.

**Reports To:** Senior Manager of Governance & Executive Services

**Who We Are**
--------------

National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants (NCCPA) is the only certifying organization for physician assistants in the United States. Established as a not-for-profit organization in 1974, we are dedicated to assuring the public that board certified PAs meet established standards of clinical knowledge and cognitive skills upon entry into practice and throughout their careers. All U.S. states, the District of Columbia and the U.S. territories rely on NCCPA certification as one of the criteria for licensure or regulation of PAs.

**Location:** NCCPA is a hybrid work environment with our headquarters located in Johns Creek, Georgia. NCCPA has determined that the telecommuting status of this position is hybrid, which means employees in hybrid positions are allowed to split their work hours between working remotely and working onsite at the NCCPA headquarters.

The duties of this position require the candidate to report onsite to the Johns Creek headquarters, at minimum, on a weekly basis and live within commutable distance. NCCPA has defined commutable distance as within the State of Georgia and within 85 miles of ground transportation, one-way between an employee’s primary residence and the NCCPA headquarters in Johns Creek, Georgia.

**Why Work at NCCPA**
---------------------

We get to do meaningful work every day, and we enjoy working and having fun together! We’re proud to be recognized by the Atlanta Journal-Constitution as a **Top Workplace** in the metro Atlanta region.

**How Will You Make a Difference? You will…**
---------------------------------------------

* Help plan and coordinate in-person and virtual meetings and events, keeping schedules, logistics, timelines, and details organized from start to finish.
* Coordinate participant travel, including flights, hotel accommodations, ground transportation, itineraries, and travel communications.
* Support a variety of meetings and events, including Board and committee meetings, conferences, summits, and other organizational events.
* Schedule and coordinate virtual committee meetings, including invitations and meeting communications.
* Work with hotels, venues, vendors, and other event service providers to coordinate meeting and event needs.
* Assist with event-related expenses, including invoices, expense tracking, and budget monitoring.
* Support safety and security planning for in-person meetings and events.
* Provide administrative and logistical support for meeting, event, and travel activities.

**Hard Skills You Will Have**
-----------------------------

* Associate degree or an equivalent combination of relevant education and experience. Relevant experience in lieu of education will be considered.
* Experience organizing and coordinating in-person meetings, events, or similar activities, including schedules, logistics, and event details.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office/Microsoft 365, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and SharePoint.
* Experience managing schedules, timelines, and multiple priorities or deadlines.
* Ability and willingness to occasionally work extended hours and travel as needed to support meetings and events.

**Soft Skills You Will Bring**
------------------------------

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills with a strong customer-service mindset.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through.
* The ability to stay organized and adapt when priorities or event needs change.
* A collaborative approach when working with staff, Board and committee members, vendors, and other stakeholders.
* Professionalism and sound judgment when communicating and coordinating with others.
* A dependable, proactive approach to keeping details, responsibilities, and deadlines on track.

**Extra Skills You Can Bring Along**
------------------------------------

* Experience using project management tools such as Wrike or similar platforms.
* Experience using travel planning or travel management tools such as Perk, AMEX GBT, or similar platforms.

* Experience working with hotels, venues, vendors, Destination Management Companies, Convention and Visitors Bureaus, or other event service providers.

* Experience supporting Board or committee meetings, conferences, summits, nonprofit or association events, or similar gatherings.

Reports to: VP, Strategic Accounts

Peer Roles: Care Coordinator Team, Client Operations

Direct Reports: None

I. Role Summary

The Account Manager supports the management, retention, and growth of Pharma Strategies' client and PBM relationships. This role is responsible for day-to-day account coordination, partner communication, onboarding support with enrollment, program reporting, and follow-up activities that help clients successfully adopt and expand the Enhanced Care Management Program (ECMP).

Working under the direction of the VP of Strategic Accounts, the Account Manager helps maintain strong client relationships by responding to routine requests, coordinating internal resources and pharmacy partner, monitoring account activity, disseminating weekly reports, and ensuring that commitments and next steps are completed on time.

This role collaborates closely with the Care Coordinator Team, Strategic Accounts including PBM partners and Pharmacy partners, Client Operations, Technical Operations, and Business Development to support successful partner implementation, ongoing program adoption, and account growth.

II. Primary Responsibilities

Account Coordination and Support

* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in managing relationships with PBMs, employer groups, and other client partners, including network pharmacies.
* Serve as a market-facing ambassador for ECMP and Pharma Strategies’ mission, representing the company with professionalism and communicating the program’s value to clients and partners.
* Serve as a day-to-day contact for routine client questions, requests, and follow-up activities.
* Coordinate client meetings, prepare agendas, support Director of Patient Onboarding for weekly touchpoint calls. Document meeting notes and distribute action items.
* Track account commitments, deadlines, open issues, and next steps.
* Escalate strategic, technical, or operational opportunities to the appropriate leader.

Client and PBM Retention

* Help monitor the health, satisfaction, and engagement of assigned accounts.
* Maintain and initiate regular communication with client contacts and respond to requests in a timely, professional manner.
* Track enrollment performance and other assess account risks.
* Gather client feedback and share relevant insights with internal teams.

Program Adoption and Growth

* Monitor ECMP adoption, enrollment, and engagement across assigned accounts.
* Prepare routine account updates, enrollment reports, and performance summaries
* Identify participation trends, gaps, and potential opportunities for increased adoption. Monitor members through the ECMP patient journey.
* Coordinate outreach and follow-up activities that support employer-group enrollment and engagement.
* Share observations and potential growth opportunities with the VP of Strategic Accounts.

Reporting and Documentation

* Maintain accurate and current client records, contact information, meeting notes, action items, and account plans.
* Assist with recurring client reports, presentation materials, and internal account reviews, including Quarterly Business Reviews.
* Maintain organized documentation in approved company systems.
* Handle client and program information in accordance with applicable privacy, security, and confidentiality requirements.

SOP and Process Support

* Follow established standard operating procedures for partner onboarding, account management, and group expansion.
* Support consistent execution of account management workflows as the organization grows.
* Support the VP of Strategic Accounts in developing, updating, and refining policies, procedures, and workflows by contributing input and assisting with documentation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Work closely with:

* VP, Strategic Accounts to execute account strategies, support client relationships, and coordinate growth initiatives.
* Client Operations to ensure services are delivered in alignment with partner expectations.
* Technical Operations to document, track, and resolve system or reporting needs.
* Care Coordinator Team to coordinate client-related service needs and resolve routine issues.

IV. Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree in business administration, healthcare administration, communications, marketing, or a related field preferred.
* One to three years of experience in account management, customer success, client services, project coordination, healthcare, pharmacy benefits, or a related area.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and follow-up items.
* Ability to build professional relationships with clients and cross-functional colleagues.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools.
* Experience with CRM, project-management, or client-reporting systems is preferred.
* Interest in healthcare, pharmacy benefits, employer-sponsored health programs, or population health is preferred. Ability to handle confidential information with discretion and safeguard patient information in accordance with applicable privacy requirements and company standards.

V. Core Competencies

* Client service: Responds professionally, follows through on commitments, and helps create a positive partner experience.
* Organization: Maintains accurate records and effectively manages timelines, tasks, and competing priorities.
* Communication: Presents information clearly and adapts communication to internal and external audiences.
* Collaboration: Works effectively across departments to support shared client objectives.
* Problem-solving: Identifies issues, gathers relevant information, and escalates concerns appropriately.
* Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and completes work accurately and on time.
* Learning agility: Quickly develops knowledge of the ECMP, pharmacy benefits, account-management practices, and company processes.

**Operational Partnership & Field Support**

jobs.title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
At Too Good To Go, we have an ambitious mission: to **inspire and empower everyone to fight food waste together.**

More than 1/3 of all food produced in the world is wasted. And that has a huge impact on the health of our planet. 10% of greenhouse gas emissions come from food waste and loss.

Through our marketplace app, we connect businesses that have unsold, surplus food, with consumers who can buy and enjoy it at a discount of the retail value. Alongside our marketplace app, we create educational tools, explore new business solutions, and influence legislation to help reduce food waste.

We’re looking for an exceptional **Enterprise Customer Success Manager** to join the team at Too Good To Go to lead the US partnerships.

**Your role**

As a **Enterprise Customer Success Manager**, you will play a pivotal role in driving the success of our most strategic partnerships. You will be responsible for managing a portfolio of key account partners, building and sustaining strong relationships with senior stakeholders. With a proactive, consultative, and data-driven approach, you will identify opportunities to increase meals saved, grow account value, and expand product adoption. By deeply understanding each partner’s business challenges, you will deliver tailored solutions aligned with our value drivers, ensuring long-term mutual success.

In this role, you will oversee the full account lifecycle from onboarding through to ongoing optimization. You will lead the development and execution of strategic account plans, conduct regular performance reviews such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and focus on driving retention at both HQ and store levels. Your ability to effectively pitch our full product portfolio will be key to introducing new categories and enhancing partner engagement. Collaborating closely with Sales, Store Operations, and Marketing teams, you will ensure strong store coverage, optimize supply quality, and deliver a seamless partner experience, all in support of our mission to reduce food waste.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Drive Account Growth**: Own the health and success of your customers from launch through expansion, with a focus on optimizing meals saved.
* **Analyze and Manage Risks**: Analyze store data to forecast meal savings accurately. Identify, communicate, and manage store risks proactively throughout the year, and lead in developing resolution strategies.
* **Provide Consultative Support:** Offer expert recommendations on food-saving practices
* **Lead Client Meetings:** Regularly lead and present at client meetings, both in-person and via video conference, to ensure alignment and progress.
* **Onboard and Train:** Oversee the execution of client programs, ensuring they are implemented effectively and deliver the expected value. Train new stores, collaborating with both store-level contacts and senior stakeholders to ensure a smooth process.
* **Manage Portfolio Autonomously**: Take ownership of your portfolio, maintaining strong relationships and meeting business KPIs independently.
* **Enhance Team Scalability:** Contribute to the scalability of the key account team through effective documentation and process optimization.
* **Advocacy and Impact:** Act as the voice of the client within Too Good To Go, advocating for their needs and contributing to our mission of reducing food waste through successful partnerships.

As a proactive, organized and experienced “quarterback”, you will excel in the following areas:

* **Communication:** Polished and effective communication with stakeholders and team members to ensure that we deliver a high quality client engagement with our key account.
* **Value & Solution Selling**: Experienced in solving complex business pains through solution selling, using data to influence decisions and successfully expanding partnerships through targeted upselling and cross-selling.
* **Account Strategy**: Effectively manages pipelines and portfolios, driving partner engagement and loyalty while setting benchmarks through strategic, collaborative account leadership.
* **Technical Skills:** Experience with sales CRM, project management and analysis tools like.. Salesforce, Ninja, Looker, Asana, as is a high competency with google drive (sheets, docs, decks).
* **Problem-Solving Skills**: Critical thinking and adaptability are essential for identifying and addressing issues as they arise during the project.
* **Project Management:** Meeting monthly meals saved milestones is critical, so time management skills and the ability to work in multiple stages of launch for different regions is imperative.
* **Organizational Skills:** Effective documentation and resource management to ensure will be critical to the successful launch and continued rollout of our key partner.
* **Cool Cucumber:** The ideal candidate is an individual who not only loves a challenge but also thrives in the face of occasional ambiguity.

**Requirements**

* Previous experience in sales, customer success, business development, or account management - specifically selling into VP+. Industry experience that translates well include: food, hospitality, media and technology.
* Strong accountability and demonstrated ability to effectively manage and meet key performance indicators (KPIs)
* Master communicator, you know when to speak, you know how to listen, and you know how to engage a whole room and keep their attention.
* Strong commercial acumen and appropriate assertiveness to drive deals forward.
* Proactive, solution-focused mindset with a strong emphasis on growth and curiosity.
* Polished, detail-oriented professional with a humble and collaborative attitude.
* Data analysis skills with raw data to create performance reports and projections to identify and understand trends, opportunities and issues.
* Enthusiasm for sustainability, food waste reduction, and environmental issues.
* Experience with value-based selling and/or MEDDICC methodology (preferred).
* Bachelor

jobs.title: Business Development Representative - Chicago
jobs.description:
Business Development Representative

Aware Health is on a mission to break the pain cycle, and we are looking for a dynamic Sales Development Representative (BDR) to join our team. This is a key role for us as we expand, and you'll have the chance to be part of our growth journey from the ground up. As an BDR, you'll help fuel our pipeline, identify new business opportunities, and contribute to the success of our Account Executives. The right person will have the opportunity to grow with us, with potential leadership opportunities, unlimited earning potential, and equity in the company.

About Aware Health

50% of the workforce shows up to work in pain due to musculoskeletal conditions ranging from acute pain, like muscle strains, to more chronic pain. People with MSK conditions are often misdiagnosed and are treated passively with opioids, injections or surgery. Often, these expensive and risky treatment methods can be avoided altogether with more modern approaches to preventing, diagnosing and treating MSK pain. Our platform gets people the right amount of help, avoiding inappropriate and unnecessary tests, drugs and surgeries. Our approach has resulted in positive outcomes for our members and has saved self-funded employers up to 59% annually in MSK costs.

About the Job

You'll be a key player in identifying, qualifying, and generating new business opportunities. Reporting to our SVP, Growth, you will be an integral part of our sales engine, contributing to the identification of potential clients, nurturing leads, and setting up meetings for our Account Executives. You'll be expected to drive top-of-funnel activity, helping to build relationships and create demand for our solution. We will invest in your growth, give you exposure to the full sales cycle with our SVP, Growth as a mentor, and ideally promote you into an AE role down the line.

We’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, startup environment, is energized by sales challenges, and can adapt to changing needs. The right person will help us shape our outreach strategies, improve processes, and contribute to scaling our efforts. If you’re excited by early-stage growth and enjoy building something from the ground up, this is the role for you.

Metrics

Leading Indicators

* Leading Indicator: Activity
* Leading Indicator: Meetings booked per month
* Leading Indicator: Meeting to opportunity conversion rate

Outcomes:

* Number of sourced opportunities
* Closed/won revenue

Responsibilities

* Build our pipeline! Prospect and generate leads through cold calling, emails and social selling
* Be the first point of contact: Qualify inbound leads and set meetings for account executives
* Build and maintain relationships with innovative brokers, ecosystem partners and prospects
* Evangelize Aware Health’s value proposition, building demand for our solution
* Keep data updated in Hubspot CRM
* Strategically contribute to and drive the development of outreach strategies
* Collaborate with account executives to optimize conversion rate and sales pipeline
* Participate in the continuous improvement of the sales process (your voice matters to us!)
* Share insights about market trends and feedback from prospects to help refine our go to market strategy
* Partner with the Head of Growth to nurture and work deals from initial prospecting through close (we’re excited to train you up so you’ll be closing your own deals in this complicated industry over time!)

Why You’ll Love This Role

* Real-time access to executives who are invested in your growth
* A collaborative and fast-paced start up environment where your voice matters
* An impact-driven mission where you can feel great about the product you’re selling
* A clear career path to AE and beyond

Qualifications

* Experience in sales or lead generation, preferably in health tech, insurance, or a B2B sales environment
* Proven track record of meeting activity and lead-generation targets
* Excellent communication skills with a focus on relationship-building and consultative selling
* Self-starter with the ability to succeed with limited resources
* Familiarity with CRM systems, preferably Hubspot
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment
* Personal qualities of persistence, grit, and adaptability

Compensation and Benefits

* Base salary $65-$75k with an OTE of $130k - $140k and uncapped earning potential
* Equity in the company
* Medical (PPO, HMO, HDHP), dental and vision
* FSA administration
* Life Insurance
* Short/long term disability
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Commuter benefits
* 401K

jobs.title: Production Operations Coordinator

Description:

**Job Summary:**

The Operations Coordinator provides administrative, analytical, and systems support to the Plant Director and Sr. Operations Manager. This role serves as a central coordinator for operational processes, ensuring follow-through on actions, maintaining management systems, organizing critical information, and supporting operational decision-making through reporting and analysis.

The position is responsible for coordinating production schedules, documenting meetings, maintaining action registers, supporting root cause analysis processes, auditing management systems, and preparing reports that enable the leadership team to execute effectively.

**Responsibilities of the Position:**

**Operations Support**

* Support the Plant Director and Sr. Operations Manager with daily operational coordination.
* Maintain calendars, meeting schedules, and operational priorities as assigned.
* Prepare reports, presentations, and operational communications.
* Coordinate and track department deliverables.

**Production Scheduling Support**

* Assist in creating, maintaining, and communicating production schedules.
* Monitor schedule changes and update stakeholders.
* Identify scheduling conflicts and escalate risks.
* Maintain schedule documentation and revisions.

**Daily Management System Administration**

* Maintain Daily Management boards and associated reporting.
* Ensure KPIs are updated accurately and on time.
* Support preparation of leadership meetings and review materials.
* Track performance trends and identify missing information.

**Action Management**

* Capture actions from operational meetings.
* Maintain centralized action registers.
* Track due dates, owners, and completion status.
* Drive accountability through routine follow-up.

**Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Coordination**

* Ensure investigations are completed according to expectations.
* Monitor corrective actions and effectiveness reviews.
* Compile RCA summaries and trend reports.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Collect, organize, and analyze operational data.
* Prepare recurring reports for leadership review.
* Develop dashboards and performance summaries.
* Investigate operational trends and support special projects.

**Auditing & Compliance**

* Audit operational systems for compliance to standards.
* Verify completion of required documentation.
* Identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Provide audit findings and follow-up recommendations.

**Continuous Improvement Support**

* Support implementation of operational improvement initiatives.
* Maintain project tracking logs.
* Coordinate project updates and status reporting.
* Assist with standardization efforts across departments.

Other duties as assigned by Management.

Requirements:

**Knowledge/Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to influence without authority
* Ability to ensure actions are documented, assigned, and completed
* Ability to maintain accuracy of reports, schedules, and management systems
* Ability to identify issues and follow through until they are resolved
* Ability to turn information into clear updates and actionable insights
* Ability to help move projects and initiatives forward quickly
* Bilingual in Spanish preferred, but not required

**Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree, bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience
* Experience supporting operations, manufacturing, scheduling, project coordination, reporting, or administrative functions
* Experience working with Excel and other Microsoft Office applications
* Experience in a manufacturing environment
* Experience with production scheduling, reporting, or performance tracking
* Experience supporting continuous improvement, audits, or problem-solving activities

**Food Safety Responsibilities:**

* Attend all food safety training sessions (GMP, SQF, HACCP, Allergen, Food Facility Security, Preventing Foodborne Illness)

**Working Conditions:**

* Office setting and warehouse environment with temperature range of 55 – 80 degrees
* This position may require the employee to work weekends or shifts other than their own to meet the needs of the business.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Regular walking through manufacturing and warehouse areas.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during audits and observations.
* Ability to use computers and office equipment frequently throughout the day.
* Occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.
* Ability to wear required PPE while entering GMP environments.

* Experience leading employee training and skills development programs.
